passages.title: A Flickering of Hope
passages.text:
This pervasive darkness continues to cast shadows over our fields, hindering our harvests.

Check with Keyrra Flamestonge and see if you can help restore some order.

passages.title: A Flickering of Hope
passages.text: There is always work to be done, <name>. Your assistance in illuminating additional keyflames would instill hope and allow many here to return to work.

passages.title: Defender of the Flame
passages.text:
The Expedition forces face formidable adversaries.

Drawn like moths to our keyflames, creatures of all types are intent on snuffing out the light and thwarting our rebuilding efforts.

Please help us defeat two of the most menacing denizens that threaten our keyflames. Together, we can drive back this darkness.

passages.title: Right Between the Gyro-Optics
passages.text: Ezgi is going to be upset, but you and I did what needed to be done.

passages.title: Dalaran's Most Distressed
passages.text:
I don't trust this big bug at all. He let me lay there ages without saying anything!

But if he wants to give us access to Siegehold, let's use it. I saw some other people dragged away into other parts of the base. I don't think they're eating them. It looks more like they're transporting them somewhere.

Let's gather them up, make a prisoner convoy, and roll on out. Find me outside!

passages.title: Dalaran's Most Distressed
passages.text:
Wow... this is a LOT of people.

But they're all miserable. Fortunately, that's just the flavor we need to sell my idea.

This could work.

passages.title: Just Act Casual
passages.text:
It's time to get outta here with the prisoners and those pheromones. I've found some convincing chains, since we have such a big group. Long as everybody stays in character, our chances look good. 

We've only got General Anub'azal's marker scent goop for you and I, so we'll be the drones with permission. You do all the talkin', while I mind the cart. I hope this works.

Lead us through the gate, <name>!

passages.title: Just Act Casual
passages.text: Let's take a quick breath. We didn't lose anyone, did we?

passages.title: To Rambleshire
passages.text:
There's word of troubles in the village of Rambleshire, at the base of Thunderhead Peak. 

Can't abide the place myself. Always wet and rumbling.

But Rooktender Lufsela thought it worth a look, however, seeing as how the birds fancy the moss that the village produces. She's still green though, and might just need a hand.

passages.title: Heroes Never Die
passages.text: Make haste, <class>. Time is of the essence.

passages.title: Reforged Purpose
passages.text: That's all of them! Now, it's time to do my duty and recast these tools. Reforge them, and myself, into what I was meant to be: a proud machinist of the Ringing Deeps.

passages.title: Reforged Purpose
passages.text:
I can't thank you enough for all of your help. I lost my faith, but now, I have both my faith and my tools back.

I'm forever grateful to you.

passages.title: Frayed Legacy
passages.text:
Keep true, <race>t.

We of the Woldguard uphold an ancient promise to Freya to tend to these lands. Our edict is older than those wielded by the demagogues in Dornogal. Older than Dornogal itself.

However, not all lands have been tended equally. The leader of our order was to care for the basin nearby but we've not heard from them in many cycles.

I have sent a novice to investigate. Aid them and my order will be in your favor.

passages.title: Frayed Legacy
passages.text: This is not as this basin should be. We have much work to do.

passages.title: Invasive Cuisine
passages.text: <This rarely seen plant may be of use to Chef Dinaire.>

passages.title: The Rise of the Reckoning
passages.text: We will make the nerubians regret ever thinking they could push into our home!

passages.title: Cage, Match
passages.text:
When we were scouting before you arrived, we saw a lot of cages set up around Velhan's Claim. Typically, the kobyss use these to hold their victims until they're needed for a ritual sacrifice.

Those sacrifices lead to... lots of other dark activities. Not the least of which is eating the victims.

Let's get ahead of all that. Take my torch, and destroy the cages, so we don't have to see that happen to anyone from Velhan's Claim.

passages.title: Cage, Match
passages.text:
Good work, <name>. Without their cages, the kobyss won't be able to take prisoners.

No prisoners means no foul rituals, and preventing those gives us a much better chance of saving the people at Velhan's Claim.

passages.title: If It Leads, It Bleeds
passages.text: Did you find their leaders? They look strong, but I'm sure you're up to the task.

passages.title: Situational Awareness
passages.text:
Regardless of what history Taenar and Velhan have between them, we need to take care of the people here at Velhan's Claim.

adventurer, will you please check in with the families here? Let them know we're here to help.

See if they're worried or need anything. And reassure them that the Lamplighters will drive back the kobyss.

passages.title: Situational Awareness
passages.text:
We're here to help. But I've learned in the past, that there are times hope and reassurance can be the most urgent need.

While you were talking with the residents, Taenar and I have determined what our next steps are going to be. 

We need to give the people room to breathe, but we also need to prepare them to fight.

passages.title: Teach a Man to Fish
passages.text:
adventurer, the people of Velhan's Claim have been locked up inside, afraid of the dark, for too long. 

And there's plenty to fear out there, but these are capable, strong people. They should be driving the kobyss away, not hiding behind their walls. 

Get these spears to the people of Velhan's Claim. They've learned to hide from their problems, but we'll give them the means to take their lives back!

passages.title: Teach a Man to Fish
passages.text:
I think now we'll see them acting very differently, now that they're armed, <name>.

There's something about knowing you can take care of yourself, that you can handle your own problems, and you don't need anyone to rescue you.

Of course, we Lamplighters will always be there to help, but it's very likely that we won't be needed next time.

passages.title: Reclaiming Velhan's Claim
passages.text: How's it going out there, <name>? You sending those creatures of darkness back to the deeps?

passages.title: Controlled Demolition
passages.text: There's more to be done. We can't let this corruption spread.

passages.title: Controlled Demolition
passages.text: Maybe we've only killed a few skardyn from a much larger swarm. But we have to start somewhere.

passages.title: Before I Depart
passages.text:
I can feel my energy reserves depleting.

I will soon not be able to execute my duties. That is why I have Urtago here to take over.

Before my systems grind to a halt, I must make sure Mourning Rise is free of kobolds. They have invaded the memorial site I tend and plunder the Unbound shrines and bodies that are there.

Maybe it is good you are here. You may have the strength to help us.

Please, help Urtago rid the site of kobolds.

passages.title: Before I Depart
passages.text:
Korgran still calls himself the caretaker, but I'm the one who has been taking care of Mourning Rise for some time.

I don't mind. Korgran is very kind. 

But the situation here has gotten away from me. We have some work ahead of us.

passages.title: Who Runs This Fine Establishment?
passages.text:
While you were dealing with the tunnels and the workmasters, I saw a peculiar kobold go into a cave to the northwest. The kobolds seemed to respect him more than the others, calling him Grand-Heister Bokk and offering him the food you call "cheese." This makes me think he is the real mastermind.

If that kobold is in fact the real Ward of this operation, then we should take the opportunity to strike him down.

I will meet you at this cave.

passages.title: Who Runs This Fine Establishment?
passages.text:
I am happy to see you, <name>.

I feel my inner workings grinding--that's a sign of anxiety. Korgran nears his shutdown with every passing moment, and then this place will be under my care. 

It is a lot of responsibility. But I believe that I am ready for it.

passages.title: Lost Delivery
passages.text:
<You find a small yet heavy leather-bound package on the road with an attached label.>

Gundargaz Courier Express

EXPEDITED

To: 
Harvester Farnee
Durgaz Cabin

OPEN WITH CARE: Contains volatile elemental minerals.

passages.title: Lost Delivery
passages.text:
Well, smoke the hive... you found it! I still can't believe the courier just lost my package...

We've been waiting on this to help with Shalehoof's leg. 

Mixed with fire honey, this stuff should patch him up quickly!

passages.title: A Shadow Over Gundargaz
passages.text:
You look dangerous.

<Toki spits on the ground.>

That's good. We need dangerous. Something is stalking Gundargaz. 

Something mean. 

Something... recent. 

Just before the Coreway collapsed I started getting reports of workers going missing mid-shift. Only thing we've been able to find have been the odd chunk of rock.

Fingers, mostly. 

If you could sniff out what's stalking my town, I'd be in your debt.

passages.title: A Shadow Over Gundargaz
passages.text:
A demon? Escaped from the crashed ruins of a flying magical city?

If you say so. 

I'm just glad it's sorted.

passages.title: Heeeelllp!!!
passages.text:
Hey! You!

Get me down! Away from these worms! Please!

I'll pay you! I'll even owe you one! Heck, I'll gladly sell out any cartel member you need dirt on! 

Just get me down!

Also, don't walk too much. They can hear your footsteps. Move from rock to rock if you don't want a swarm coming after you.

passages.title: Weapons and Warriors
passages.text:
Gorloc raiders have been slaughtering these farmers and stealing their pearls. They seek our protection, but we may not be enough.

I know of others nearby who can help. Seek them out and request their aid. If they are hesitant, offer them the promise of pearls as payment.

We will also need to arm these farmers so they can defend themselves. Search for spare weapons and equipment that they might be able to use.

I will go with the farmers and train them as best I can.

passages.title: Weapons and Warriors
passages.text: Good work. I'm glad you were able to recruit some fighters. It is worse than I expected, and we will need every one we have.

passages.title: Frontline Farmers
passages.text:
Most of the farmers are already out in the field, defending their positions. I have trained them as best I could given the circumstances, but they are still wielding farming tools. 

I need you to distribute the weapons you gathered to those on the frontlines. While it may not markedly improve their combat ability, at least it will boost their confidence that they are not alone in this fight.

passages.title: Frontline Farmers
passages.text: Excellent. As long as they fight together and for each other, I believe we will be victorious.

passages.title: Follow Miral
passages.text:
Tomothy's lynx, Miral, has been bugging me. I don't know what she wants but it is unusual to see her without my brother. She's a great farm cat, but she's still a cat, so maybe she's just bored with Tomothy today? I don't know. Maybe Tomothy got into some sort of trouble.

Can you find out what is bothering her for me?

passages.title: Save Tomothy
passages.text: You saved my idiot brother from the darkness! Thank you.

passages.title: Expert Consultant
passages.text:
You alone are no longer sufficient. We require additional assistance, and the jawcrawlers and threadlings also need oversight.

The niffen settlement, Mmarl, is not far. However, past forced conscription attempts have failed. Nerubians are now forbidden within the settlement. We need someone to communicate in our stead.

Go and barter with the rats. Come back with able bodies.

passages.title: Bright Young Niffen
passages.text: Have you found anyone yet?

passages.title: Rak-Ush Under New Management
passages.text: Excellent.

passages.title: Beetle in a Haystack
passages.text:
There are still feral stagshells on the outskirts of Rak-Ush.

This scent grenade should be sufficient in stunning the beasts and alerting the niffen to their location.

Once they are stunned, one of the rats will take them back to their hollow.

Capture them and bring them back. We will be waiting.

passages.title: Beetle in a Haystack
passages.text: Excellent work.

passages.title: Permanent Hire
passages.text:
Rak-Ush is beginning to look like a functioning swarmery.

The role of delegation has suited me and Vix'aron well. You will continue to aid the niffen. In return, you may keep a portion of the wealth the swarmbeasts produce. 

Saffrin has more detailed plans around the development of the swarmery. Go speak to him, I have nothing else to say to you.

passages.title: Permanent Hire
passages.text: You have not spoken to Saffrin yet, have you? Otherwise you would not be here.

passages.title: The Outland Cup Begins
passages.text: Skyrider! Lord Andestrasz has left the Dragon Isles and is visiting Stormwind. He's looking for capable skyriders like yourself to compete in new races!

passages.title: Alone in the Dark
passages.text: <The bizarre creature's eyes remain locked upon you, unwavering. It nudges something towards you--a scroll with a thick seal of violet wax.>

passages.title: The Nibelgaz Refinery
passages.text:
Quickly! Elementals have overrun the Nibelgaz Mine and the refinery crew are trapped down there with them. 

I am especially worried about my fused, Munderut. His memory is not the best these days. If you are a friend, rescue him and the refinery workers.

Here, take this healing clay. It only helps a little, but it should be enough for any injured to make their way back. I wish we had a rejuvenating crystal, but that is the stuff of legends.

passages.title: The Nibelgaz Refinery
passages.text:
The workers told me that you helped them escape the refinery. Task complete! 

I'll take the clay back now. Gratitude.

passages.title: Rampage in the Refinery
passages.text:
Catastrophe! Oh, this is awful. Awful! Those accursed slag heap elementals are keeping my refinery workers from being able to do their jobs.

Duty demands we carry on our work. These delays will not be tolerated. You look competent enough. Go on, get down there and get to work destroying elementals. Production must not be slowed!

passages.title: Rampage in the Refinery
passages.text:
What a terrible delay in production. The miners will have to work twice as hard to make up for lost time, I am afraid.

It is good you came around when you did. Those elementals are a menace. An awful menace!

passages.title: Gutting the Pool
passages.text:
The kobyss are... a bit larger than I expected, and I might--might, you understand?--have more trouble with them than I originally anticipated.

Kill any stupid fish-faces you see.

passages.title: Gutting the Pool
passages.text:
You've killed a lot of them.

I wouldn't mind if you killed more. Just saying.

passages.title: A Final Goodbye
passages.text:
Well, parents avenged, fish killed, more fish killed, biggest fish killed. 

Pretty good day.

I guess I should go burn stuff.

passages.title: A Final Goodbye
passages.text:
Thanks, <name>. I'll make sure to put in a good word with General Steelstrike for you. I know her well. 

Well, I met her once. 

Well, I saw her in the street.

But I did think about talking to her, so it's the same thing really.

passages.title: Seeds of Salvation
passages.text: Have you planted the seeds?

passages.title: Supply the Effort
passages.text: Have you recovered the stolen items?

passages.title: Web of Manipulation
passages.text: Have you solved our spider problem?

passages.title: The Lost Flame
passages.text:
<A tinderbox of a Hallowfall Expedition member, its return would help honor the memory of those who bravely gave their lives.>

An expedition scout might possess knowledge about this item.>

passages.title: A Small Bag of Seeds
passages.text: <This small bag of seeds seems forgotten, perhaps Aliya Hillhelm could make use of them.>

passages.title: The Glittering Shard
passages.text:
<Glistening with an inner light, this shard of crystal feels warm to the touch..

Orsenth may be interested in examining this piece of ore.>

passages.title: The Last Journey
passages.text:
This lantern is perfect.

Enough of this. It is time! I can feel my memory clouding. We have to get going. Urtago is waiting for us. They will join us on my final journey to Mourning Rise, where we will conduct a ceremony.

<Korgran forces a smile.>

It is nothing fancy, I promise. As I said, it is more symbolic than anything else.

My head feels heavy. What was I doing again? Hmm, oh, right! Meeting Urtago!

passages.title: The Last Journey
passages.text:
<name>, we have to find Korgran! If he keeps on exerting himself, he will shutdown in the middle of nowhere.

And it's not safe for him to be out in his condition. He would be easy prey for stormfangs and even kobolds.

passages.title: A Change of Tradition
passages.text:
An Unbound earthen can't return to the Coreway, so we have Mourning Rise. But looking at Korgran, remembering our last conversation before...

I may not be the Mourning Rise caretaker just yet, but with Korgran's condition, it falls to me to be in charge. 

As Unbound, we made our own rules and traditions. So what if he doesn't want to stand at Mourning Rise? If a seaside memorial is what Caretaker Korgran wants, that's what he gets.

<name>, meet me at the shore to the southeast of here.

passages.title: A Change of Tradition
passages.text:
He enjoyed the walk, but it has taken a heavy toll on him.

Korgran barely recognizes me now.

passages.title: Everyday I'm Snufflin'
passages.text: Perhaps the kobolds of Gundargaz would be interested in this Odd Glob of Wax.

passages.title: Entrepreneur, Inc.
passages.text: Skedgit actually found something out there? She always did have a good nose for business.

passages.title: A Clutch of Hope
passages.text:
<The broodmother lies dead, coiled around a single egg. She gave her life to keep it from the spiders.

You should take it to Nebb. He and the other Grubtenders would know what to do with it.>

passages.title: Tending to the Terrified
passages.text:
All happen so fast. One moment, we gathering eggs and grubs. Next, spiders swarming.

Nebb drag me here, many others trapped. Caught in webs, soon to be feasts. Must save the Grubtenders. 

We tenders, not fighters. Do not let friends become meals.

passages.title: Tending to the Terrified
passages.text: Aha, Grubtenders free! They survive to harvest again.

passages.title: Report to the Councilward
passages.text:
Those receipts you found... Steelvein is a known smuggler that we've been chasing for a long time. The Councilward will be pleased to finally have solid evidence on his activities, and maybe even on his whereabouts.

Bring these receipts to Merrix immediately. He will want to study them in detail. He said he was heading back to his office, so you should be able to find him at the Councilward's Rise.

I'll package up the rest of the evidence to be brought to him later. Good work today.

passages.title: Forcing My Hand
passages.text:
I will have this solved peacefully.

Though if Ardgrin asks for violence, we will answer.

passages.title: Bad Business
passages.text:
I have not been to the Deeps since their machines shut down. Obstorn will have to guide us to Ardgrin's depot.

Once there, I will attempt a conversation. If Ardgrin is not amenable, which I suspect will be the case, we will respond with equal force. Our goal is to bring him back into the fold, not to beat him into submission. Ruling by fear only breeds resentment.

We will meet you in the Deeps. Come swiftly--and, of course, speak of this to no one.

passages.title: Bad Business
passages.text:
Now that Ardgrin is willing to talk, we will talk. And all of this will be settled.

You have my gratitude, <name>.

passages.title: Holy Hydrocarbons
passages.text: These devotional candles might be of interest to Janky the kobold candlesmith in Gundargaz.

passages.title: Deep Wax Galactic
passages.text:
While sourcing it may not be pleasant, this waxy substance seems like it might make a fine candle.

Janky the candlesmith in Gundargaz might be interested in this.

passages.title: Trade Partners
passages.text: Hey there <name>! Thanks for catchin' up with me.

passages.title: Muddled Mind in the Mine
passages.text:
The workers said they saw Munderut near the back of the mining area. Please find him and tell him that I said he needs to report back in. 

He might not remember me, or that I am his fused. Tell him to look down at his chest, at the medallion he wears. His memory of our time together fades in and out these days, but the medallion tells of our story and bond forever.

passages.title: Monsters in the Dark
passages.text:
The local quarry was an active source of clay and ore for us until the fungarians took over some time ago.

We were worried about the fungarians encroaching upon the village, but there's something more.

Multiple sightings of a creature much larger than our native wildlife have been reported at night.

Combined with villager Modhina's disappearance, I fear this is no coincidence. She visited the quarry recently and hasn't returned.

We would be in your debt if you searched the tunnels.

passages.title: Monsters in the Dark
passages.text:
A stonestalker, here? Their habitat resides far beneath the isle's surface. All the recent change must be disturbing them.

Regardless, thank you for slaying it. They are highly territorial and kill for sport.

As for the tunnels, the area sounds beyond recovery. We'll have to let nature reclaim it.

passages.title: Buried, Not Forgotten
passages.text:
Several suns ago, my friend Modhina ventured into the quarry cave. She wanted to find rare ore for Hreka, to help her craftsmanship. Modhina was excited, I remember. A rare feeling for earthen.

She hasn't returned. The fungarians prevent us from searching the area.

It would mean a great deal to us if you could look for her. I didn't know it was possible to spend so much of the day thinking about what if's.

passages.title: Buried, Not Forgotten
passages.text: You've returned! Did you find Modhina...? What is all that you are carrying?

passages.title: Raging Rifts
passages.text:
Destroy what rifts you come across, but above all, find their source! I suspect you will find it deep inside the nearby cave.

The miners you rescued spoke of breaking through to a crystal-filled room, and of the elementals pouring forth from within.

passages.title: Social Clues
passages.text:
<The nerubian keeps her voice low, a careful eye on the guards behind you.>

The Weaver sent you, yes? I arrived to petition the Magistrate's approval for Ascension--to infiltrate high society, of course.

But he's missing. A rather large inconvenience.

I need to ask around. You're just what I've been waiting for! You may pretend to be my... servant. Pet? Whatever makes it more palatable to you.

I so rarely get to work alongside a friend. We will have fun together, fellow spy.

passages.title: Social Clues
passages.text:
I knew Ascension changed people, but... They were my friends. And now, they don't even want to be seen with me.

It makes me wonder... if I succeed in all this, will I even still be myself?

<Tx'itk shakes her head.>

It doesn't matter. I'll do what needs to be done.

passages.title: Pulling Strings
passages.text:
Just think of it! Overcrawlers, war prisoners, civilians, fellow nerubians, important nobility being kidnapped and turned into puppets right under the Magistrate's nose.

It's horrific--and exactly what I needed! If we save the Magistrate from this fate, he'll owe me. Not just for saving his life, but to keep quiet about all this.

We're off to the theater, then. If you can keep the Puppetmaster occupied, I'll free High Elevator Etak'kaht from his grasp.

Hopefully he's not part of the show yet.

passages.title: Pulling Strings
passages.text:
I'm thrilled. There couldn't have been a more perfect opportunity to get the Magistrate's attention. And the Weaver will be pleased to hear we have him in our pocket indefinitely, with this blackmail situation.

Now, I suppose I'm off to the Transformatory.

<Tx'itk shudders subtly.>

I... I must not let my resolve falter now. The Weaver has asked this of me. I will be her eyes.

passages.title: How Scandalous!
passages.text:
Move along. This is an ongoing--Oh, <name>, my apologies.

We may actually need your assistance.

passages.title: An Oddball in Dornogal
passages.text:
We have received reports that an eccentric Arathi is accosting our citizens. We have little experience with outsiders and my superiors are wary of a diplomatic incident.

I have been tasked with finding this "Lamplighter" and resolving his concerns. You have worked with the Arathi before - can you assist me?

I have a list of earthen who have reported the Lamplighter. You can interview half the list. Between us, we can hopefully locate the Arathi before he troubles more citizens.

passages.title: An Oddball in Dornogal
passages.text:
This is not quite what I was expecting.

He is certainly odd but a troublemaker? I think not.

passages.title: Found Around the Unbound
passages.text:
This Lamplighter is looking for his fellow Arathi. The foreman says he directed an Arathi shipwright to Freywold Village.

My superiors insist that Peacekeepers do not leave Dornogal... but per their orders, I must assist Kaerter. And to do that, I have no choice but to leave the city.

<Leif quickly hides a smile.>

It is decided then. If you are willing, please meet us at Freywold Village. Your continued aid would be appreciated.

passages.title: Found Around the Unbound
passages.text:
It seems the locals have taken issue with our foreign companion. I am attempting to defuse the situation as best I can.

But we have more pressing problems.

passages.title: The Abductors' Obstructors
passages.text:
The Order of Night is clearly interested in our resources. They have abducted earthen to harvest for them and may continue taking others. We must stop them.

The next largest earthen settlement is Rambleshire. If the Order needs more workers, they might have gone there to get them.

Go on ahead <name>. I must first speak with Kaerter about why the Arathi are doing this.

passages.title: The Abductors' Obstructors
passages.text:
While we have not yet seen any Arathi, there is an uneasiness about the town.

Kaerter believes the Order is here. He says they are simply waiting for a moment to strike.

passages.title: Ungirthin' the Earthen
passages.text: Well done. I will lead the few I was able to rescue to safety.

passages.title: Concealed in the Weald
passages.text:
The nerubians seem to be in league with the Arathi. Many of them are guarding the mill, but I am sure there are more than we can see.

We cannot allow such a large enemy force to operate unimpeded this close to Rambleshire.

The nerubians attacked and destroyed large sections of Dornogal not too long ago. The Order of Night Arathi are abducting and enslaving our people.

We must eliminate as many of them as we can. Preferably all of them.

passages.title: Concealed in the Weald
passages.text: That should disrupt their operation. Let us hope it is enough for now.

passages.title: A Lamplight for the Shipwright
passages.text:
Where is Kaerter now? Did he go off on his own again?

<Leif sighs.>

We've rescued the earthen and eliminated many hostile forces, but our task is not yet complete.

Shortly before you arrived, we spotted a group of Arathi traveling up this hill. One of them was identified as the Arathi shipwright.

The shipwright is the leader here. Losing her will cripple their efforts to utilize the mill.

Head up the hill and find her before she can escape.

passages.title: A Lamplight for the Shipwright
passages.text: Kaerter is injured. He will not be an effective fighter until he heals.

passages.title: Gasping Plea
passages.text:
<A gasping, pathetic-looking fish taken from the corpse of a kobyss flops weakly in your hand. Its beady eye twitches, and you suddenly hear a breathless voice in the recesses of your mind.>

The water. Take me to the water. Away from these kobyss wretches. Away from the sky.

passages.title: A Light of the Dark
passages.text:
The image of a purple candle, burning with glorious power springs unbidden to your mind as you contemplate the decaying filth before you, followed by a faint whisper echoing through your mind: "One candle to rule them all, and in its brightness bind them."

Bring Janky the candlesmith in Gundargaz enough Coagulated Black Blood to forge a most unfortunate candle.

passages.title: The Caretaker of Brunwin's Terrace
passages.text:
Greetings, outlander. You must be the problem solver I've heard about! I'm Caretaker Batzvara. I tend to earthen who have gone into stasis, like our friend here.

I often patrol Brunwin's Terrace to honor my fellow earthen with an offering of cinderbrew. Recently, however, I've drawn the attention of a local species of moles. They have a nose for sweets, and greedy claws for all else.

You look like you can defend yourself. Will you accompany me to pay respect to those who have gone into stasis?

passages.title: The Caretaker of Brunwin's Terrace
passages.text: Gratitude expressed. Your reputation as a stalwart ally is well-deserved.

passages.title: Shimmermist Falls
passages.text:
West of Gundargaz is another green space - a lovely area with waterfalls and more terraces. My schedule takes me in that direction next, and I would be very glad of your company to help deal with the wildlife there as well. 

If your other duties are not pressing, let us meet there.

passages.title: Shimmermist Falls
passages.text: You made it! Let us get to work.

passages.title: A Sassy Arathi
passages.text:
I had heard that an Arathi was making trouble in the city. It sounds like he is butting heads with the peacekeepers.

You've worked with the Arathi before, haven't you? Maybe you'd be able to smooth over any ruffled feathers.

passages.title: A Sassy Arathi
passages.text: Yes, how can I help you?

passages.title: Don't Cry for Me, Azj-Kahet
passages.text:
<You find a crumpled page of journal paper wrapped around a small key.>

I always suspected Arax'ne was a traditionalist, but I didn't think she'd go this far. I don't know where I'm going, but I just have to get away from her.

To whoever finds this, it means the worst has come to pass. This key unlocks a chest that contains all my worldly possessions. They are yours.

All I ask is that you avenge me by slaying Arax'ne.

passages.title: Dread in the Den
passages.text:
You kobold friend, yes? Need help. Bad things happening in the Chittering Den. 

Glumtooth Gang setting up camp. Cronies of Candle King, want war with earthen.

Can't stop them alone. Meet me at camp.

passages.title: Dread in the Den
passages.text: You came. Good. Much to do. Much to protect.

passages.title: Healing the Headwaters
passages.text: Glumtooth Gang so wasteful! They leave much scrap in the water. Bad for water. Bad for scrap. Go clean it up.

passages.title: Healing the Headwaters
passages.text: Much better. Make no sense to let scrap rot in pool.

passages.title: Break out Berrund!
passages.text:
You work good. Now they let you into ring to "fight" earthen. You go to ring when ready. Cinder-flash candles could go off any moment.

I head back to camp. Wait for you and earthen there.

You good one. No get killed.

passages.title: Bump off the Boss
passages.text:
You back! Berrund came back alone. Scrit worried.

It done then? Good. Glumtooth Gang no last long without leader.

passages.title: Listener Lost
passages.text:
Blast it all! 

Brennok and I were on our way to Shadowvein Point to conduct a recitation ceremony. We were attacked by scorpids. Now the hauler has a scorpid stinger lodged in its gears, and Brennok wandered off.

He said he was going to stretch his legs while I fixed the hauler, but that was a while ago. I need to get the bot moving again, can you look for him?

passages.title: Eyes of the Weaver
passages.text: Chk-chaah! You return at least. What news of the city do you bring me, hrm?

passages.title: Hand of the Vizier
passages.text:
Thanks to your efforts, the Vizier is one step closer to parity with the enemy. 

For that, thanks are necessary.

passages.title: Broken Bracelet
passages.text:
That is... 

<Keyrra carefully places the bracelet in her palm.>

I can't believe it.

passages.title: One Last Story
passages.text:
I knew Brennok was acting odd. Then one of the miners mentioned you'd borrowed a spare set of clothes. That and his strange mood, well, it wasn't hard to guess that he planned to leave.

I expected him to come this way, though. Have you seen him?

passages.title: Tending to Ausgazur
passages.text:
Assigned tasks complete! I'll check back on these folks on my next scheduled patrol.

There is one more earthen I must tend to today. He was... he is very special to me.

You've been an especially considerate colleague, so I'd like for you to see him. Let us travel west a bit, closer to the falls.

passages.title: Tending to Ausgazur
passages.text:
You made it! 

<She looks at the outstretched hand of the earthen next to her and sighs.>

I admit that I am quite disturbed by what I've found here. Your presence is a comfort.

passages.title: Let's Not Worry Her
passages.text: Thank you for bringing him back. He always acts strange when we come to Shadowvein Point, but he seems more out of sorts than usual.

passages.title: To Mourning Rise
passages.text:
Greetings, outlander. My name is Urtago, and I am Caretaker Korgran's apprentice at the Mourning Rise memorial site.

The mischievous Candlelit Kobolds have overrun Mourning Rise, and we seek assistance. Would you meet me at Fallside Outpost? It is just to the north of here. I will be able to tell you more once you arrive.

passages.title: To Mourning Rise
passages.text: You are here! Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Sticks and Bones
passages.text:
While the krolusks like to attack from beneath, the Rumbling Waste also plays host to a predator who prefers to swoop down from above. Deepsflayers have built nests on the peaks and ridges around the Waste. 

Destroy their nests and show them that the Waste is no welcoming home.

passages.title: Sticks and Bones
passages.text: I could see the smoke from here! Good job! That ought to make those wretched things look for a new place to perch.

passages.title: Azj-Kahet's Next Top Dyemaster
passages.text:
Ren'khat and the Overspinner are fighting pincer-and-claw. Inside the spinneret. With no witnesses.

We have a unique opportunity here. If they took one another out... well, with Antourix's favorites dispatched and the whole of Rak-Ahat in disarray, the next best authority would be the caravan coordinator. Me.

I don't love being in the spotlight, but it would be very beneficial to our secret-smuggling operation if those two didn't make it out of the dyeworks.

passages.title: Azj-Kahet's Next Top Dyemaster
passages.text:
The sheer scandal will have the record-keepers in the City of Threads busy for months.

And I'll make sure they don't look too closely at how it happened.

passages.title: Subterfuge in Silk
passages.text:
I see our mutual "friend" got my message and sent you to aid.

Our production schedule is shot as our management struggles to assert itself.

I propose this chaos is fertile ground for the ambitious.

passages.title: Desperately Seeking Skorthuz
passages.text:
Eh? Who are you? Oh that's right, I heard that there were new folk about.

Say, are you heading north? If so, keep an eye out for my friend, Skorthuz, will you? The laggard was due back an hour ago but is nowhere to be seen. I heard he was heading towards the Chittering Den for some awful reason. 

If you see him, tell him to hurry up and get back here or I'm drinking alone!

passages.title: Desperately Seeking Skorthuz
passages.text: Who are you? Oh, Hrandaz sent you? Is it that time already?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind. Acclimate yourself and learn all you can.

Our experiences will be invaluable to the Archives back in Dornogal.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Orgrimmar. Acclimate yourself and learn all you can.

Our experiences will be invaluable to the Archives back in Dornogal.

passages.title: Unfulfilled Requests
passages.text: You must be the help the Vizier sent. Welcome to the Silken Ward.

passages.title: To Arathi's End
passages.text:
You made it. Now let's see if we can make a dent in these nerubians and save Hallowfall.

I can already taste the rewards!

passages.title: The Light's Call
passages.text: We are glad to have your support. Anything you can do to help re-ignite these keyflames will help!

passages.title: Check on the Compiler
passages.text: That's everything up here. Would you check on Brennok? Recitations can be stressful, I'm sure he'd appreciate the help.

passages.title: Regularly Scheduled Maintenance
passages.text: These are from Orren? I think they go well together, even though they're so different.

passages.title: Regularly Scheduled Maintenance
passages.text:
Wow, that's really sweet of him. I'll be here for a while, dealing with the kobyss, but I should send something back. 

So he knows I'm safe, and that I can't wait to see him.

passages.title: The Sword is Mightier
passages.text:
I had told Orren I'd be back by now, but Velhan's Claim has larger problems than I expected. The people here need my help against the kobyss.

adventurer, I've always been better with a sword than a pen. Strong feelings and being far apart makes it even harder. 

I'm more at home protecting the vulnerable than being vulnerable. 

Perhaps I could tell you what I want to get across and you could write it for me?

passages.title: Birdman of the Three Shields
passages.text:
Are you here to watch the mosswools? No? 

That's too bad. I find the elemental creatures on our isle fascinating. I'm not the only one. 

An old friend of mine named Olbarig resides out on the Three Shields. He studies the wild cloudrooks there.

But come to think of it, I haven't heard from him in awhile. Maybe someone should check on him. Hm. Would you mind?

passages.title: Ghosts in the Machine
passages.text:
There's a substation directly below us? Perhaps that is where Arbauch went to hide it... Disregard, we must investigate.

With luck, Arbauch may still be here. The entrance should be to the north, near the pool of water from the burst pipe. Please, come with me. He may need our help.

I will explain everything once he is located.

passages.title: Ghosts in the Machine
passages.text: It killed him, and we let it loose. Even his memory gem is gone.

passages.title: Duty of Care
passages.text:
The golem is unstable. I doubt it can travel far. We will track it, but haste failed me once already. Arbauch showed true devotion to the machines--we will follow his example. Repairs must come first.

Machine systems are delicate. We must activate the backup before the failure can cascade. Exterminate any pests you find as well. Even the smallest creature can ruin delicate machinery.

I am damaged. I will send my cogwalker with you to relay instructions.

passages.title: All Ore Nothing
passages.text:
Outlander. Your aid is requested. 

The earthen here have said you would be of help. 

Our fellow earthen at the Opalcreg have not reported their quota for the past day. There must be something causing a disruption. 

Would you pay Foreman Alvegar a visit?

passages.title: All Ore Nothing
passages.text:
I'm hiding... lay low. 

Foreman Germira sent you? She must be worried that we haven't sent over our quota.

passages.title: Third Mine Blind
passages.text:
I got cut off from the rest of the crew. We did not expect to be attacked by nerubians. Though I can't imagine the rest quitting.

Our duty is too important to give up just yet. 

Barging right into the mine could cause the nerubians to frenzy and hurt the others. So, I found a third way to get in earlier. Though undetected will still be tough. 

Follow me.

passages.title: Third Mine Blind
passages.text: You made it undetected, good. Time to surprise these Nerubians!

passages.title: Hit Rock Bottom
passages.text:
A long way down to be sure, but I am certain that you can make it. 

If you doubt yourself, I made some parachutes to help you stick the landing. 

Once you get to the bottom of the cave, look for Cenderragg. She's the most senior of the group and probably has the best idea on how to rescue the team.

passages.title: Hit Rock Bottom
passages.text: Who are you and why are you here?

passages.title: Web Beats Rock
passages.text:
So, Foreman Alvegar sent you? That explains it.

The situation is not great. This place is crawling with nerubians and they're showing us no mercy. They forced us to mine and took our hard-earned opals. 

When you disobey, they web you up. 

I was barely able to escape them when they came. The others... Well, that's where you come in.

With you here distracting them, I can go rally the webbed earthen.

passages.title: Web Beats Rock
passages.text: Thank the machine! They're free!

passages.title: Beetlejeweled
passages.text:
To make sure no other earthen gets harmed we're going to have to eliminate their leader. 

You know the saying, rid yourself of the foreman and the whole line collapses. 

Either way, to get to safety we're going to have to go through them.

passages.title: Beetlejeweled
passages.text:
You made it back, I was beginning to think all hope was destroyed. 

Alvegar filled me in with the issue. I'm just glad all our people are safe, and we got the opal too.

A small win, but a win.

passages.title: Time Found
passages.text:
Yer back!

If you're up for it, there's more things in the muck to be found. Might have to dig a bit deeper this time.

passages.title: Decommissioning Darkness
passages.text: Regret. This should have been my burden.

passages.title: Decommissioning Darkness
passages.text:
There is no joy in the death of a machine, but I express gratitude. I suspect Arbauch would too. 

His decisions were his own, but none can doubt that he devoted his life to the machines. The Titans would be proud.

passages.title: To Opportunity Point
passages.text: Welcome to Opportunity Point! You got a drink ticket, eh? Coming right up!

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: Lily's Locket
passages.text: <This locket must be important to someone. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Stone Tracing
passages.text:
Couldn't help overhearing. Not to brag, but goblins are specialists in the field of rampaging robots.

If that golem's as unstable as Danagh says, it'll be leaking all sorts of energy. Take this, run a few scans, and you'll find it. Oh, and be careful. Animals tend to go a little cuckoo when you power this thing on.

No charge--a murderous golem's bad for business. And I kinda feel bad making you work just to find a dead guy.

passages.title: Undoing the Damage
passages.text:
Apologies. Arbauch was not here for repairs--he stole that golem.

Arbauch and I worked alongside it for years in the darkest reaches of the Deeps. The work took its toll on the golem. It became erratic, dangerous even. We planned to decommission it, but when the time came, Arbauch couldn't bear it. He'd become attached. Before it could be destroyed, he took it and fled.

It must be found, but the damage to this substation is catastrophic. With your help, I will attempt repairs.

passages.title: Undoing the Damage
passages.text: A foreman and a substation lost. Blast. I was careless.

passages.title: City of Threads: Splice the Splicer
passages.text:
"Ascension" is no true evolution. It is defilement. It is doom. And Ansurek further etches that doom in stone with each passing day.

If we bring down the Transformatory, then we can potentially rid Azj-Kahet of these abominations for good.

Izo the Grand Splicer is Ansurek's chosen overseer of the Ascension process. Cut that wretch's head from her body, and perhaps these mutations will cease.

passages.title: City of Threads: Splice the Splicer
passages.text:
You've dealt a blow that Ansurek will never recover from, <name>.

Take this and be well.

passages.title: Badly Behaved Bot
passages.text:
Go ahead, laugh. I would be as well if I didn't have such pressing business. My bot's foot clipped a nearby rock, spilled me out and then righted herself. Without me in the cockpit! 

I'm grounded while she floats there quite cheerfully. Can you believe it? 

Listen, if you are heading up to Shadowvein Point, will you let Kagfritha know that I'll be late for my shift? I need to wait for this hunk of metal to run out of fuel and dip low enough for me to get back in the driver's seat.

passages.title: Badly Behaved Bot
passages.text: Sinruna got tossed again, did she? I keep telling her she's flying too low. Maybe this'll knock some sense into her.

passages.title: Ara-Kara, the City of Echoes: Harvest's End
passages.text:
You've seen it yourself, haven't you? The "Black Blood," as we call it.

We will not stand idle any longer. Not while Ansurek mutilates, drills, and exsanguinates our precious land for the last, fetid dribbles of the old gods' death rattle. 

Seek out the old city beneath us--Ara-Kara, The City of Echoes. You will receive a handsome bounty should you slay the crony in charge of the excavation. Her people call her Ki'katal, the Harvester.

passages.title: Ara-Kara, the City of Echoes: Harvest's End
passages.text:
Ki'katal is dead? Excellent.

You have our thanks, <name>. In both praise, and material value.

passages.title: There's Always Another Secret
passages.text:
Fascinating. This is clearly a chamber meant for a Keeper. But for what? 

We need to investigate.

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Lost Shoe
passages.text: <A shoe in the style worn by members of the Hillhelm family. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: Hillhelm Family: A Clutch of Eggs
passages.text: <A clutch of chicken eggs, they must have come from a nearby farm. Maybe Aliya Hillhelm can shed some light on it.>

passages.title: A Silken Thread
passages.text: You must be the help our "mutual friend" sent. Welcome to the Silken Ward.

passages.title: Bountiful Beetles
passages.text: Ah, so the general has sent out an observer?

passages.title: Preserve and Pretend
passages.text:
Chive dig for history. You help find? 

Got history detector from goblin. Said it finds history underground! You use. Chive dig.

passages.title: Preserve and Pretend
passages.text:
Many thanks, dig-finder. 

Chive know these have no important history... but they will one day.
 
Chive will keep safe until then. Kobolds make new history. 

Then save and protect. Forever.

passages.title: Gearing Up for Trouble
passages.text:
Greetings friend,

The machine is once again in disrepair and requires restoration. 
I am in need of your expertise to successfully perform maintenance.

A reward shall be provided for well-executed assistance.

passages.title: Stormscarred
passages.text:
Take a look around this beautiful town. What do you see? Ranchers 'n' their mosswools. But where is this rancher's flock? In the guts of a beast, they are. Stormscar they call 'im. 

Stormscar, whose howl is as the thunder. Whose bite is lightning. Whose belly is full of my life's work. 

I came here to buy weapons and all we have is ranching equipment. You look strong. Would you put an end to Stormscar's reign in our pastures?

passages.title: Stormscarred
passages.text: Thank you, adventurer. My role in this world is to be a rancher. Yours is to slay wolves. We all have our places.

passages.title: Warbands: Warbanding Together
passages.text:
<name>, some adventurers have gotten together to form a warband and could use your help.

Find Blue and her group in Gadgetzan.

passages.title: Azj-Kahet
passages.text:
An Arathi airship is stranded in Azj-Kahet following a vicious nerubian ambush.

Aid the survivors as they withstand the nerubian assault.

passages.title: The Beginning of Something Beautiful
passages.text:
<This seems like it would be of interest to a nerubian alchemist. 

Ascension is their specialty, and this may be key to understanding more about the process.>

passages.title: Delver's Call: Dread Pit
passages.text:
Two things are bad for business. Earnest competition and the Dread Pit caves. We need someone to deal with the latter!

Something bad is going on here. We lost a bunch of workers in this cave.

We need you to deal with the threat, so we can keep business booming!

passages.title: Delver's Call: Dread Pit
passages.text:
You took care of them spiders in the Dread Pit? Great!

I'll get to work on figuring out a better name for that place. "Dread Pit" just ain't catchy enough.

passages.title: Witnessing Brilliance
passages.text:
The time has finally come and the moment could not be more exhilarating. It's time to get to work.

Join me outside, let's observe the fruits of our labor.

passages.title: Witnessing Brilliance
passages.text: Well... that certainly did not go as planned.

passages.title: Stormrider's Honors
passages.text:
<A golden missive finds its way to you.>

Champion, though you are no Stormrider, you may yet be worthy of the Stormrider's armor.

Find Stormrider Bruelda if you wish to claim this honor.

passages.title: Purging the Vaults
passages.text: Send their souls howling back to Ula'tek.

passages.title: Prey: Anguish Island
passages.text: I hate it here.

passages.title: Prey: Anguish Island
passages.text:
Snakes. 

Why'd it have to be snakes?

passages.title: Prey: Something for Astalor
passages.text: Can we leave yet?

passages.title: Prey: Something for Astalor
passages.text:
<Ethrandil sighs heavily.>

Of course there are ghosts.

passages.title: Living Legend
passages.text: There's a lesson to be learned.

passages.title: Prey: Anguish from Beyond
passages.text: After you...

passages.title: Prey: Attending the Attendant
passages.text:
You're alive! I'm alive! 

Still.

passages.title: Soul Lattice Revealed
passages.text:
Riftblade Maella agrees that the Hal'hadar in the crypt must be stopped.

It may not be the crux of their operation here on Naigtal, but it is not a threat we can ignore.

passages.title: Bounty of the Cursed
passages.text: What have you found?

passages.title: Bounty of the Cursed
passages.text: We'll use de Soulcoilers' own works to purge dem.

passages.title: Decisive Incursions
passages.text: Now dat was a battle worthy of de old songs! I can see why Zul'jarra likes you.

passages.title: From Whence it Came
passages.text: Can you feel it? De violence just waitin' to spill over?

passages.title: Turn Back the Surge
passages.text: We must survive.

passages.title: Spoils of the Vaults
passages.text: Careful not to fall in de rivers of venom.

passages.title: Counter-Curse Bounty
passages.text: Careful not to fall in de rivers of venom.

passages.title: Tailing the Tlhapi
passages.text: Hmph. Should have asked for a lime, too.

passages.title: Tailing the Tlhapi
passages.text:
Oh yes, they'll do much better among the crew than they would in the open ocean.

I suspect Captain Tokka will be pleased.

passages.title: In the Catalyst's Shadow
passages.text: Ah, so you spoke with Decimus? It looks like we're on our own now. Better get started.

passages.title: Prismatic Potential
passages.text: Do you have those Elementary Voidcore Shards?

passages.title: Prismatic Potential
passages.text: I hope it wasn't too difficult to come by these Elementary Voidcore Shards. Now that we have them, I can continue my research into the void potential of the Catalyst's power. This will take a while, so check back with me later.

passages.title: Shoulder to Shoulder
passages.text: Dis is a war, <name>. No one should fight alone.

passages.title: Distance Tracker (DNT)
passages.text: Testing distance tracking. Do not translate. Not player facing.

passages.title: Prey Contract: Murloc Shadowhunter
Infinite Research: Worldly Deeds
passages.text:
All across the Broken Isles there are people in need. They search for hope but are hard pressed to find any. You can be that hope.

Seek out those in peril in the Broken Isles and be the champion they so desperately need.

It is through such acts that legends are made.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Worldly Deeds
passages.text: Somewhere, someone is in need. All they need is a champion to save them.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Worldly Deeds
passages.text: A single heroic act can turn the tide. A single whisper of hope can turn back despair. This is what gives legends their power.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Invasion Points
passages.text:
The Legion does not fight conventionally. They deceive, manipulate, and undermine their opposition at every turn.

There are no battle lines against the Legion. They will open rifts at a weak point and then spill out of it sowing death and destruction. When they invade, it is on their terms.

However, this strategy is not invincible. Potent champions, able to move and react swiftly, can stop these invasions at their source. Stop the Legion Invasion. Show people that the Legion can be defeated.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Invasion Points
passages.text: The power you and your artifact possess were able to halt a Legion invasion. But was it you, or the artifact you wield, that is responsible? On that I will require more information.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Greater Invasion Points
passages.text:
Once the Legion has sown confusion and chaos, then they will begin their real assault. Huge invasion rifts will open and the Legion will march forth in great numbers. The defenders, scattered to protect against smaller rifts, will lack sufficient strength anywhere to stop them.

That is when champions like you are most needed.

Seek out one of the Legion's major invasions and throw everything you have at it. 

Show the people that with enough determination you can cancel the apocalypse.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Greater Invasion Points
passages.text: Just as I predicted. You were able to stop a massive Legion invasion. It was not you, or your artifact that did this. Rather it was the combination of both that won the day.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare study, so focus on fighting rare opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare Elites
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare elite study, so focus on fighting rare elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare Elites
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Rare Elites
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Terrors of the Broken Isles
passages.text:
It is time to put both you and your artifact to the test.

Seek out a Terror of the Broken Isles and defeat them.

I am certain that, no matter the outcome, you will provide us with much to think about. I will be watching with great interest.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Terrors of the Broken Isles
passages.text: How fares the research?

passages.title: Infinite Research: Terrors of the Broken Isles
passages.text: A fascinating outcome, <name>. This will shed some much needed light on our research.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Broken Isles
passages.text:
Our research suggests that power is only part of the equation--what one does with it is also of great importance.

The people of the Broken Isles need a champion. Come to their aid and drive the Legion from their shores and your legend will grow.

Where you choose to start is up to you--the Legion is everywhere, so one place is just as good as another.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Broken Isles
passages.text: Your legend has grown, <name>. The timeline reverberates with not just the substance of your deeds, but it compounds as it impacts those around you. This has been a most fruitful addition to our research.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Order Hall
passages.text:
Your legend will not be satisfied with just being another adventurerc--you must prove yourself to be more.

Prove yourself within your Order Hall. Gain the respect of your peers, and become the first among equals.

In this way we may yet determine what limits you have and whether it is a person, or their artifact, that defines the legend.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Champion of the Order Hall
passages.text: You have gained the respect due to a true <class>. You are a leader. All that remains to be answered is where you are going.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Artifact Collector
passages.text:
As we study this timeline and your effect upon it, a question has been raised--what would be different if you had a different artifact?

Seek out a new artifact and let us see whether the first choice you made was good, or great.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Artifact Collector
passages.text: You have quite the collection now, <name>. All that remains to be seen is whether you prefer one artifact over the other.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Clear the Skies
passages.text:
Manipulating time is not without its risks or its rewards.

The strain on this timeline has produced numerous residual time motes through the Broken Isles. It would be irresponsible not to clean them up.

However, there is opportunity here. If you were to gather these motes, then their latent infinite power would be bestowed upon you instead.

We can clean up the timeline and enhance our research at the same time.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Clear the Skies
passages.text: This timeline is pockmarked with time motes. Gather as many as you can.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Clear the Skies
passages.text: Good. Nothing dramatic occured when you gathered the residual time motes. If you start to feel anything strange, do let us know though.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Gather Timewarped Samples
passages.text:
The fraying of this timeline has had some interesting effects on plants and stone. We would like to study them.

Gather samples of timewarped herbs and ores from around the Broken Isles and being them back for analysis.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Gather Timewarped Samples
passages.text: How fares the research?

passages.title: Infinite Research: Gather Timewarped Samples
passages.text: Moratari will be elated to see so many test samples. Thank you for your diligence.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a demonology study, so focus on fighting demonic opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Elite
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be an elite study, so focus on fighting elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Elite
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Elite
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Groverunner
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of your attunement to the forest, so focus on fighting opponents using the power of nature.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Combat Studies, Groverunner
passages.text: Impressive. I can sense your power. This is a most critical addition to our research.

passages.title: Eliminate Shatterpulse
passages.text: <Use the Shatterpulse Cell Key to reveal and eliminate Shatterpulse.>

passages.title: Eliminate Shatterpulse
passages.text: Eliminate Shatterpulse.

passages.title: Eliminate Shatterpulse
passages.text: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

passages.title: Eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer
passages.text: <Use the Arcane Lure to reveal and eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer.>

passages.title: Eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer
passages.text: Eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer.

passages.title: Eliminate Arcana-Monger So'zer
passages.text: Excellent work, I will issue a reward for eliminating this warrant target.

passages.title: Prey Contract: Zealous Crusader
Thief at Bark
passages.text:
<Luma stands in front of you, ears perked, thankful for your help.

She lets out a short bark, tail wagging once before trotting a few steps forward, then pausing.

Glancing back, Luma waits expectantly. Her body language pleads, "Come on, follow me!">

passages.title: Thief at Bark
passages.text: <Luma appears to be waiting for your approval.>

passages.title: Thief at Bark
passages.text:
<Luma nudges a small reward into your hand, as if in appreciation for your help.

Perhaps there is no reason to be concerned over the amount of stolen items in the treasure pile after all.>

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text:
We placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

While highly effective, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They must be regularly fed with latent arcana lest they weaken.

As Magisters, it is our duty to maintain the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text: We must ensure the runestones are charged and defended.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Magisters
passages.text: Your strength is matched only by your acuity, my dear. I will ensure everyone knows how marvelously you have performed today.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
passages.text:
The Magisters placed a number of runestones throughout Eversong Woods, each one charged with protective arcane magic intended to ward off the Lightbloom.

Naturally, the runestones require an immense amount of power to function. They can be fed with latent arcana, but that power draws enemies seeking to claim it.

As Blood Knights, it is our duty to defend the runestones--especially when the eyes of this Haven are upon us. Recharge their arcane power and defend them from those who would threaten us.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
passages.text: Maintaining the safety of Eversong is of utmost importance.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Blood Knights
passages.text: Your deeds honor us, <name>. You have fought well this day.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Farstriders
passages.text:
The Magisters placed a handful of runestones across Eversong, each one charged with arcane magic that wards off the Lightbloom.

As you might guess, the runestones require a huge amount of power to function. The Magisters feed them with latent arcana, but that kind of power draws a lot of attention. Bad attention.

As Farstriders, it's our duty to defend Eversong from those kinds of threats--especially when the Haven is looking at us. Go recharge the runestones and fight off whatever tries to stop you.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Farstriders
passages.text: We need to keep those runestones safe.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Farstriders
passages.text: Nice work. You know how to see a mission through smoothly. I have a few ranger recruits who could learn a thing or two from you.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Shades of the Row
passages.text:
Have you seen the runestones out in Eversong? Huge rocks full of arcane magic that ward off the Lightbloom.

I'm not the magic type, but I know an opportunity when I see one. Those runestones need a lot of power to work. If we help keep them charged, there are a lot of people who would owe us favors--and favors are even better than gold.

Here's the plan: I help you get some latent arcana, you drop it into the runestones, beat up whatever tries to stop you, then we bask in the accolades. Deal?

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Shades of the Row
passages.text: Those runestones aren't going to charge themselves.

passages.title: Fortify the Runestones: Shades of the Row
passages.text:
Ha! I shouldn't be surprised you pulled that off so well, but here we are. We've already got people looking at us like we're miracle workers.

All thanks to you, <name>.

passages.title: Something Borrowed
passages.text:
Now that you have your infinite bronze, we just need to select the right artifact for you, shape the bronze into a suitable simulacrum of the weapon, and then reach through a temporal knot and swap them.

No one will be the wiser.

All we have to do is remember to reclaim the simulacrum in this timeline and everything will work itself out.

Let's start by selecting your specialization, that'll determine which artifact we'll be borrowing.

passages.title: Something Borrowed
passages.text: Every artifacts needs a mighty hero to wield it.

passages.title: Something Borrowed
passages.text:
Intriguing. This artifact's potential has been deepened, perhaps by the fraying of this timeline. It can harness more power than any incarnation of it that I have yet encountered.

Let me record that data point for Moratari.

Oh, important reminder--don't forget to recover the bronze simulacrum later or things might get... funky.

And lastly, maybe don't mention to people how you got that. It could ruin the experiment.

passages.title: Charge of the Vanguard
passages.text:
Turalyon reports the Vanguard of the Light is prepared to march on Xal'atath's stronghold.

Would that I could join you for the charge. I will keep my retainer of forces here to maintain the defense of the Sunwell and Silvermoon while you take the fight to our enemy. 

Muster in the Voidstorm, take the fight to the Voidspire, and bring an end to this great enemy. Good hunting.

passages.title: Charge of the Vanguard
passages.text: Good, <name>! You have made it for our charge.

passages.title: Cowardly Cheery Bombs
passages.text:
Goblins love bombs, I get that. But does EVERYTHING have to blow up?

Do me a favor: In the next Dastardly Duos match you enter, find a cheery bomb inside one of the wooden tree and planter props.

After you find the bomb, but before it "blows up"... smack it for me. Don't worry, they're cowards.

passages.title: Cowardly Cheery Bombs
passages.text: Those cheery bombs are asking for it, <name>. Find one in a Dastardly Duos match and smack it!

passages.title: Cowardly Cheery Bombs
passages.text: Way to go, <name>. You have to show those bombs who's boss, you know?

passages.title: Request of the Arcantina
passages.text:
Ah, <name>!

I hear you have a standing invitation to Archmage Khadgar's... Arcantina?

Can you go there for me and bring this missive to the Archmage? I need to source reagents for the sheer volume of telemancy spells I have been asked to conjure.

Magister's Terrace has been an excellent source up until recent events but really I need the Kirin Tor to loan me some of their harder to find ingredients.

passages.title: Request of the Arcantina
passages.text: Champion? Do you have something for me?

passages.title: Request of the Arcantina
passages.text:
Hmm. Let's see here.

Warpstalker eyes, an astral sieve-

Jormungar bile?! How does he plan to use that? And I am down to my last few vials. 

Well, it can't be helped. I will send these on to Oculeth as soon as they are gathered. In the meantime, enjoy yourself around the tavern, Champion.

passages.title: Borrowing Corruption
passages.text:
Adventurer, I have made an amazing discovery. 

Analyzing the memories from the time I have discovered that I might be able to recreate the corruption effects that have been wielded in the past. Albeit in a much more controlled way. 

I will need you gather some black blood residue from defeating the bosses of the Corrupted or Lost areas of the map and a few more of the displaced corrupted mementos.

passages.title: Borrowing Corruption
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Borrowing Corruption
passages.text:
Yes, by combining this residue with the displaced corrupted mementos I can... yeah just like so... and then with a bit of my bronze magic... there. Done.

Now that I have a working knowledge I can also make more if you bring me additional displaced corrupted mementos. I will see if I can refine the process anymore. Check back with me later.

passages.title: The Broken Sky
passages.text:
All those people. Our army. Our heroes. Our leaders.

Gone.

We are exposed here. Umbric's tether saved us, but we need to ensure we survive this. Report to Lor'themar and tell him what transpired in the Voidspire. I will get Umbric to safety and learn what I can here.

passages.title: The Broken Sky
passages.text:
This is a dark day. 

I am deploying my scouts to learn more of what is transpiring in the world while we use our remaining forces to defend Silvermoon City. 

Be ready, champion. We will have need of you soon.

passages.title: Enhancing Corruption
passages.text:
Welcome back adventurer. I have made a new discovery but I need to test it out. 

Hidden in the Lost areas of the Horrific Visions I believe is a rare black blood coagulate. This might be the key to increasing the power of the corruption effects... in a safe way. 

If you can go into these areas and find this item and also bring me back more displaced corrupted mementos I should be able to increase the potency of the corruption effects.

passages.title: Enhancing Corruption
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Enhancing Corruption
passages.text:
Ok, this is promising... the coagulate catalyzes slower so the increased corruption is more contained... yes, this allows a higher yield of corrupted material without any negative side effects.

Alas, I cannot keep it stable for long. These effects will not last. I am sorry adventurer but we should take advantage of the effects while we can. 

Again, if you bring me additional displaced corrupted mementos I can make you more of these greater corruptions.

passages.title: The Listener
passages.text:
Now that you've learned about our legends, you've earned the notice of one of our elders. He wants to meet you.

His name is Aksem, and he knows things that the rest of us have never learned. History that remains hidden, even in the paintings.

Go and introduce yourself. He's expecting you.

passages.title: The Listener
passages.text:
Yes, I wanted to speak with you. 

There are many truths that are hidden, even to the oldest living haranir. Continue to learn and they may be revealed.

Show respect to our history, and I will eventually tell you more.

passages.title: In the Name of the Goddess
passages.text:
The high priest Aksem has asked for you again. He said you are not the only one on a quest for knowledge about the deep history of Harandar.

Go to him. I believe he already has another guest who is also interested in learning this hidden history.

passages.title: In the Name of the Goddess
passages.text: Tea will calm your thoughts.

passages.title: In the Name of the Goddess
passages.text:
Thank you for the tea, student.

As you can see, you are not the only one with questions and ambition in equal measure. Keep searching, and keep learning.

Soon I will call you for the next lesson.

passages.title: The Stolen Staff
passages.text:
This time, I do not have a story for you. 

Instead, Aksem has asked that you meet with him to help recover the next of the relics. Go to speak with him, and he will tell you more of what you must do.

passages.title: The Stolen Staff
passages.text:
Good. You return. 

Something important has been stolen, and I wish for you to retrieve and return it to Kassameh. Are you ready?

passages.title: That's Not Yours
passages.text:
The rutaani in the Blossoming Terrace are crafty. They've trained their petalwings to search and grab anything shiny that rolls down from the Den.

And, I suspect, sometimes they grab things that haven't naturally fallen.

So we want to get those things back. That's where you come in.

Go into the terrace, and don't hesitate to use force to send a message. That's a language we all understand.

passages.title: That's Not Yours
passages.text: Have you found those missing things?

passages.title: That's Not Yours
passages.text:
You found quite a few things. Including...

... Wait, that's mine. I thought I'd lost that.

<Seila mutters foul words about thieving birds.>

passages.title: Nested Clues
passages.text:
You're looking for a staff called the Root of the World. It's a powerful twist of woven roots, back from before the haranir traveled deep into the mountain.

It's irreplaceable, as Aksem knows. So if a rutaani petalwing stole it, that's embarrassing. The only way for everyone to save face is to get it back.

Search the nests of the bigger birds. They've been trained to look for more valuable items.

passages.title: Nested Clues
passages.text: Have you found where the staff might be?

passages.title: Nested Clues
passages.text:
You found nothing?

Shame.

Maybe you're not looking in the right place.

<Seila looks at you intently.>

passages.title: To the Blossoming Terrace
passages.text:
When the haranir first arrived in Harandar, they brought with them a staff formed of the roots of a great tree. That tree has since gone away, but the roots remain.

It has been our duty to protect that staff and pass it on through the generations, but now it has been stolen.

Your task is to find it and return it to Zur'Ashar Kassameh.

Go into the mists below the Den and seek out the Shul'ka. They will guide you on your search.

passages.title: To the Blossoming Terrace
passages.text:
I greet you, student of the Cradle.

Aksem sent word that he'd toss someone down here to help find the missing staff. I don't often see others from the Den, other than the foolish ones who wander down.

You're not one of the foolish ones, are you?

passages.title: The Root of Things
passages.text:
Looks like you didn't find any sign of the rootstaff among all the thiever's nests. That's a good thing, honestly.

But there's more to this test than just recovering stolen goods. Yes, it's a test. You're seeking secret knowledge. That means something here doesn't add up, and the real answer is waiting to be found.

So, come find me when you're ready to get that answer.

passages.title: The Root of Things
passages.text:
Well done. Yes, I asked Seila to take the staff in order to test your dedication.

You've proven yourself. You have earned the right to learn more about it, and about our history.

passages.title: A Legend to Know
passages.text:
I am entrusted with many secrets, and the benefit of that is not having to explain myself often.

You have recovered the Root of the World, as I asked. Now, take it to Zur'ashar Kassemeh, and learn more about it.

There will be more for you, later.

passages.title: A Legend to Know
passages.text:
The Root of the World! I'm glad to see it returned to its rightful place.

Come, let's unlock its history and learn more about how the roots have shaped Harandar.

passages.title: Once More Into the Rift
passages.text:
Aksem has asked for you again. He says he's ready for you to undergo the final ritual for the knowledge he wants to teach you.

I admit, I'm envious, but I do not envy the trials you'll need to undergo in order to prepare for this knowledge.

Go speak to Aksem, and do as he says. Orweyna will be joining you.

passages.title: Once More Into the Rift
passages.text:
<Orweyna breathes carefully and steadily, her eyes slightly unfocused. Then, she sharpens her gaze and looks at you.>

I'm glad you're here. I admit, I am nervous about what we will learn. I have heard only one story of the goddess for as long as I can remember.

To know that there is more to the story, it... it fills me with curiosity and dread.

But as Aksem said, there is no going back now. And we are ready.

passages.title: Shrouded by Aln'hara
passages.text:
As you know well by now, the creatures in the rift are infused with the essence of Aln'hara. What we need is that essence mixed with water.

Aksem wants us to collect water here and then infuse the essence of Aln'hara into it. I can only imagine what it might be used for.

passages.title: Shrouded by Aln'hara
passages.text: The voice is as strong as ever here.

passages.title: Shrouded by Aln'hara
passages.text:
It's done. But I swear... I can hear the goddess' voice mixed with pain, now. 

What are we about to learn?

passages.title: Ritual Reinforcement
passages.text:
You know the dangers of the Rift of Aln, but this is the best place to prepare for the kind of ritual Aksem wants to perform.

Go about the rift and place offerings to prepare yourself.

passages.title: Ritual Reinforcement
passages.text:
You handle the power of Aln'hara well.

I'm beginning to think it was foolish to make you challenge me.

passages.title: The Dreamrift: Malformed Mystery
passages.text:
We have prepared ourselves as best we can for the next stage. Now, we must venture into the deepest part of the Rift of Aln.
