Into the Dreamrift.

It's a place so dangerous that even the Shul'ka hesitate to go, but we must. Aksem needs us to collect the most powerful infusion of Aln there is.

Are you ready?

passages.title: The Dreamrift: Malformed Mystery
passages.text:
You've survived the Rift of Aln on a number of occasions, but what walks the Dreamrift is a horror of its own category.

Now you have everything you need for the ritual. I might say that the hard part is done, but that would be a lie.

The hard part is knowing the truth of the Cradle of Aln'hara.

passages.title: The Empty Cradle
passages.text:
You have ventured far, fought deep, and learned many things about our history to be here.

Now it's time to know the truth. Prepare yourself.

passages.title: The Empty Cradle
passages.text:
Now you know.

The goddess' loss is felt most keenly here, and you understand why. It's a pain that is etched in the very land, in the water, and in the manifestations of Aln.

This is a truth that you and Orweyna will need to bear.

I only hope that one day we can bring Aln'hara our comfort, to soothe her agony and her grief. This is the vow I have sworn, as have many haranir.

We will bring our goddess home.

passages.title: The Elves Assemble
passages.text:
The time for preparations have passed. Xal'atath's forces are upon us.

Join us, champion, as we must rebuff this assault and then press our attack on the Darkwell.

passages.title: Quel'Danas
passages.text:
Champion, the time has come to see an end to the Darkwell.

I do not know what awaits us beyond the gates of Quel'Danas, but we cannot tarry any longer. The Void continues to pour into the Darkwell, transforming it. 

Arator is at the head of our combined armies. He has asked you and your strongest allies join him at his side. 

It is time to end this and take back our well.

passages.title: Quel'Danas
passages.text: Here we stand. Here we fight.

passages.title: The Cult Within
passages.text:
<A missive written on shimmering vellum unfurls before you.>

adventurer,

Rumors suggest that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, has been recruiting in Alliance cities. Meet me in Stormwind to investigate these rumors. If the cult is there, then we must stamp it out at once.

Magister Umbric

passages.title: The Cult Within
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>. The Twilight's Blade cannot be allowed to roam our cities.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text:
Apocalyptic threats have taken many forms in Azeroth's history, but today we face Xal'atath and her Twilight's Blade.

I fear that people are falling into hopelessness as the Radiant Song cries a warning. The Twilight's Blade could use that despair to draw them into their ranks.

My mages have identified this district as housing a peculiar amount of void energy. Investigate and stop any cultists you may find.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text: I understand the comfort the void can provide. But surrendering to it completely is not the peace many are led to believe.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text:
There are Twilight's Blade in the city. If they are here, they are certainly recruiting elsewhere.

We have more work to do.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text:
The cult of twilight has long been dedicated to ending Azeroth. That they ally with Xal'atath is no surprise.

If the Twilight's Blade are indoctrinating citizens, we must stop them. We cannot permit the weak to fall to the Void's dark designs.

The Cleft of Shadow is home to many practitioners of unsavory magic. Identify and end any cultists you may find there.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text:
<Rommath sneers at you.>

The calm and comfort the Void offers is a lie. You would do well to abandon it.

passages.title: Avoiding Blame
passages.text:
The Radiant Song casts a long, dark shadow on Azeroth. The Twilight's Blade are taking advantage of it.

We have work to do.

passages.title: The Twilight Highlands
passages.text:
I've spoken with Grand Magister Rommath. Despite our differences, it seems we are aligned in purpose.

We have both found evidence that Twilight's Blade cultists are convening in the Twilight Highlands. It's a place long scarred by the cult's misdeeds. And it's a suitable staging ground for an attack.

Meet us there so we may continue our investigation.

passages.title: The Twilight Highlands
passages.text:
Well. It seems we are to be working together to investigate the Twilight's Blade.

I do hope you're prepared.

passages.title: The Twilight Highlands
passages.text:
I've received word from Magister Umbric. He has found similar evidence that the Twilight's Blade are recruiting in Stormwind.

The Void poses an existential threat to all of Azeroth. We must stop the cult at its source.

We've agreed to meet in the cult's homeland, the Twilight Highlands. Find me there so we may continue our investigation.

passages.title: The Twilight Highlands
passages.text:
Good, you've arrived. 

Keep an eye on our allies. We may be working with them to stop the Twilight's Blade, but the Void is insidious. 

They cannot be fully trusted.

passages.title: The Cult Within
passages.text:
<A missive written on fine parchment unfurls before you.>

adventurer,

I have heard unsettling rumors that Xal'atath's cult, the Twilight's Blade, is recruiting within Horde cities. Meet me in Orgrimmar so we may root out this evil. We cannot suffer a single cultist within our walls.

Grand Magister Rommath

passages.title: The Cult Within
passages.text: Good, you're here. We cannot let the Twilight's Blade gain ground in the city.

passages.title: Midnight Dress
passages.text:
Cult activity in the area has risen significantly. While we are gathering troops, you secure a cultist disguise and infiltrate their nearby training grounds.

Find out anything you can about the Twilight's Blade and their goals. I will keep this area secure.

passages.title: Midnight Dress
passages.text: You look lost, fledgling. Isn't there somewhere you should be?

passages.title: Midnight Dress
passages.text: You hardly seem prepared to serve Xal'atath. We shall fix that.

passages.title: Xal'atath's Proven Faithful
passages.text:
It takes more than blistering desperation for the apocalypse to be part of the Cult of Twilight.

We are Xal'atath's Twilight's Blade. Our purpose is greater than it has ever been before. And thus, we must become her strongest allies.

Go and train with my associates in the field. Educate yourself on our rituals and rhetoric. Only then will I allow you to go through the initiation ceremony.

passages.title: Xal'atath's Proven Faithful
passages.text: Excellent. You have the bearing of a true acolyte of the Twilight's Blade.

passages.title: More Doom
passages.text:
Having completed your training, you have earned full membership with the Twilight's Blade.

<Harrowtongue pauses a moment, appearing self-satisfied.>

As a member of the cult, you will now join your fellow acolytes in an initiation ceremony. They are in the basement of this building receiving instructions from our great leader, Mor'duun.

Allow his words to fill you with zeal for the cause. The end is near!

passages.title: More Doom
passages.text: Have you discovered more about the cult's plans?

passages.title: More Doom
passages.text: I suppose aligning with yet another being hellbent on ending the world is only fitting for the Cult of Twilight.

passages.title: Cult It Out
passages.text:
Mor'duun and his Twilight's Blade cultists are directly supporting the Harbinger's dark designs for our world.

And that is all we need to know. Kill as many as you can, then meet us back at our base of operations.

The cult and its leaders must be eliminated.

passages.title: Cult It Out
passages.text: Their nefarious alliance with Xal'atath is clear. Good work. Now we take them down.

passages.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat
passages.text: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>

passages.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility
passages.text: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important. The Explorers' League would be interested in this.>

passages.title: Cracked Keystone
passages.text:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash though your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?

passages.title: Oaths and Heirlooms
passages.text:
You, stranger... do you know of the Shadowguard that left K'aresh in ruins?

My sister was lost in the conflict, her heart forcibly turned to the Void, but I swore oaths to my family... to cherish them no matter their transgressions.

My sister, Veraan, is surely lost, but if I were to recover her necklace, at least then my oaths would be upheld in spirit.

I am a simple tinkerer. I've tuned this device to track the Shadowguard, but I cannot face them alone.

Would you help me?

passages.title: Oaths and Heirlooms
passages.text: Keep yourself out of sight. I would rather not risk a bleak fate.

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
The Dragon Isles is a dangerous and uncharted place. We'll need to get you prepared.

You're strong enough now that you should choose a combat specialization.

This will unlock a new array of abilities for you to face the dangers within the Dragon Isles.

Go ahead and choose your combat specialization.

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text: Having trouble? You can find your combat specialization beside your spellbook.

passages.title: What's Your Specialty?
passages.text:
Excellent choice! I'm looking forward to what you do next.

Take this riding mount. It'll help you get around here faster.

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text:
Before you head off, you'll want to get yourself a Hearthstone. 

This little stone will return you to the inn where you last bound it to.

It's not much of an "inn", but the explorers have a tent set up. 

Test out that new mount of yours and ride over to Sil'nori Crestshade. He'll get you sorted out with a Hearthstone.

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: Sil'nori Crestshade nearby can get you set up with a Hearthstone.

passages.title: Home Is Where the Hearth Is
passages.text: If you ever find yourself lost, use your Hearthstone to get yourself back to where you should be.

passages.title: Aiding the Dragon Isles
passages.text:
It's time for us to part ways. I have pressing business further within the Dragon Isles in a place called the Azure Span.

Naleidea Rivergleam of the Dragonscale Expedition could use your help.

Safe travels, <name>. I look forward to our next meeting!

passages.title: Aiding the Dragon Isles
passages.text: How are you? We could use more hands to help us explore the Dragon Isles!

passages.title: Fits of Lucidity
passages.text:
While I've been lurking, I've been listening.

These Shadowguard appear to have a minor rebellion on their hands. Some of the ethereals are acting erratically. They're being rounded up and questioned.

What's going on here?

Dispatch some of these Shadowguard and intercept their intel. I'll decode anything you bring back to me.

passages.title: Fits of Lucidity
passages.text:
I thought the Void coursing through these ethereals was all-consuming.

And yet, there seem to be some able to resist its infinite darkness.

passages.title: Fits of Lucidity
passages.text:
Something has sparked a rebellious fire in some of the Shadowguard.

Let us see what more we can find.

passages.title: Distant Memories
passages.text:
I swore an oath to honor my family... difficult when my sister was converted to the Shadowguard. She may not be here, but tracking the Shadowguard has led me to this place. 

I'm looking for a necklace that belonged to my sister Veraan. It's odd... I've noticed many K'areshi heirlooms discarded around here. It seems the Shadowguard wish to destroy any reminders of our home world.

If you bring some of these trinkets and baubles to me, we can see if there are any I recognize.

passages.title: Distant Memories
passages.text:
These keepsakes are some of the last remnants of our home world.

The memories they contain are powerful. The Shadowguard is right to fear them.

passages.title: Distant Memories
passages.text:
I do recognize some of these items! They belonged to close friends and family.

If my sister's necklace is to be found, it will be here.

passages.title: Truth From Power
passages.text:
Thanks to your intel, we have learned that the rebels are being interrogated by Questioner Xen'daan.

It is said that after being questioned, the rebel ethereals are being taken somewhere to be "dealt with."

The head questioner is sure to know more. If we can find where they've taken the rebels, there may still be hope for them.

passages.title: Truth From Power
passages.text:
At the risk of getting my hopes up... do you think Veraan could be among them?

Could I face her now? After the atrocities she's committed in the name of the Void?

passages.title: Truth From Power
passages.text: <name>! This necklace belongs to Veraan! Veraan IS Sombersong!

passages.title: She Started the Fire
passages.text:
Veraan is sure to be amongst the rebels taken to Shadowguard Point.

Her fiery spirit fills me with great pride!

I came here expecting to say a farewell of sorts. I did not come here expecting to find my sister.

Perhaps it's not too late, <name>!

passages.title: She Started the Fire
passages.text:
Veraan's essence may have been twisted by the Shadowguard, but the rebellion gives me hope.

Can the dissidents be snatched from the Void's grip entirely?

passages.title: Eating Their Own
passages.text:
The Shadowguard seem to have no qualms caging and torturing their own kind.

The last thing I want is more violence amongst the people of K'aresh, but better them than us.

Disrupt their operation by subduing some of the Shadowguard.

passages.title: Eating Their Own
passages.text:
Degrees of evil is not a question I expected to be pondering.

Let us save who we can and agonize over merits later.

passages.title: Eating Their Own
passages.text: Violence is rarely an occasion for celebration, but I am glad we have at least slowed the deeds occurring here.

passages.title: Techno-Magnetic Pulse
passages.text:
The betrayers are being held in stasis chambers.

I've seen these cages before. Their design is efficient but fragile. They will fail with the slightest energy variation.

Find crackling energy vessels strewn about and heave them at the stasis chambers. With true aim, you will disable them and free the betrayers.

passages.title: Techno-Magnetic Pulse
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>. You helped me see my sister again. For that, I can never repay you.

Veraan is changed. Angry. Tormented by despair. Let us tread delicately.

passages.title: Those Left Behind
passages.text:
In the wake of Xal'atath's destruction, what remains of our forces are gathering at the Darkwell to determine what we can do about the remnants of the Void.

We cannot abide the presence of so much dark energy. Some of our greatest casters and most knowledgeable scholars believe they might have a solution, but we could use your aid.

Please, join Arator at the Darkwell at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Those Left Behind
passages.text: Thank you for coming. It is fitting we have you here for this day.

passages.title: In Times of Need
passages.text:
The last of the other elven leaders have returned with powers from their homeland that will help us in cleansing the Darkwell. 

While the Voidstorm no longer barrages the Darkwell, it still needs healing. 

Please meet with the other leaders and let them know we are ready for them.

passages.title: In Times of Need
passages.text: Elves of all nations have spent ages upon ages drawing upon wells for magic, for life, and for identity. Not even the dragon aspects could surpass our knowledge in this hour.

passages.title: From Darkness, Light
passages.text:
We will not let the Sunwell be corrupted again. This Darkwell must change, but it must change to something that we are no longer bound to with such dependency. We do not need this well to be the bait for so many other world-corrupting forces.

No, today we heal the Darkwell, and make it something new. Let me know when you are ready.

passages.title: From Darkness, Light
passages.text: Behold the Dawnwell. May its waters never know corruption. May it stand as a reminder of all that we have lost, and an inspiration for what we can become.

passages.title: It's All in the Image
passages.text:
So, the higher-ups in the marketing department say you need a good partner to soften your aesthetic of... you know, "murder everyone around me for gold."

We've got two focus group approved goblins over there ready to go, so go take your pick. Sassy will handle the paperwork.

Oh, don't give me that look. You only gotta forever-love each other in front of the public. Once the cameras are off, no one cares. It'll be great for your reputation!

passages.title: It's All in the Image
passages.text: C'mon, this ain't rocket surgery. Pick whoever you wanna pose on some magazine covers with.

passages.title: It's All in the Image
passages.text:
There we go! Nice and artificial, just like all the best marketing should be.

And I just finished the paperwork for your other big image upgrade. I think you're really going like this!

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text:
Ah, ye're here! Brewfest is here and we've got a small problem. We can't have a proper feast without the food, but some pesky hozen thought it'd be fun to steal our bags of grub. I'm sure they're just lookin' to fill their own bellies, but it's messin' up our plans!

So here's what I need ye to do: hunt down those hozen and take back the bags they've snatched. There's a good chance ye'll find a few bags just sittin' on the ground too. When ye return, just add the recovered bags to that wagon back there.

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text: The feast won't come together without those ingredients!

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text: Ah, ye've done it! The cooks will be pleased.

passages.title: The Silversun Compact
passages.text:
Champion. 

After much discussion, negotiation, and even some screaming and three duels, the Sunreavers and the Silver Covenant have decided on a course of action to define both of our futures.

Given your aid in getting us to this day, we would like you here to act as a witness as we formalize and sign our peace accords. Will you do us the honor of igniting the Flames of Remembrance?

passages.title: The Silversun Compact
passages.text: Strange times. Strange times indeed.

passages.title: The Silversun Compact
passages.text: It is done. Today marks the first day of the Silversun Compact. May the oaths we sign ourselves to today bind us in trying times to do the right thing.

passages.title: Reluctant Hand
passages.text:
Champion, I felt it was important to have you here for this moment so that neither I nor my wayward former peer get off topic with his many failings.

I also want a witness in case he turns to evil. 

Would you be so kind as to unpack a few items so that I do not have to touch them?

passages.title: Reluctant Hand
passages.text:
I am not so filled with pride that I cannot admit to some... mild nostalgia for the banter I once enjoyed with my former peer. 

Magister Umbric was once quite the source of counterpoints and suggestions that went beyond expectations, and helped push our knowledge of magic further and further.

passages.title: Reluctant Hand
passages.text:
So, we help save the city and in return, I'm allowed to have my old things back.

From anyone else, that would be an insult. From Rommath? The highest of praise.

Oh, he even kept my old alembic... how thoughtful.

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text:
Now that ye've gathered the materials, we can get to cookin'! We'll need plenty o' food for the whole crowd.

We've got a short but sweet menu: Barley Soup, Pretzels, and of course a good ol' brew!

Are ye ready to learn the ropes?

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text: Get cookin'!

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text: Ah, I can smell the pretzels from here. Ye've cooked up a spread that'll keep even the pickiest dwarves satisfied!

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text:
Ye've done well in the kitchen, now it's time to learn how to serve! Brewfest isn't just about food--it's about makin' sure everyone has a good time.

Ye'll be takin' orders, deliverin' dishes, and pourin' drinks with a smile.

Get out there and show 'em how it's done. Brewfest won't run without good service!

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text: Remember to serve with a smile!

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text: I'd say ye've earned yerself a nice break and a brew after all of yer hard work. But don't get too relaxed! There's still plenty to do to keep Brewfest runnin'!

passages.title: Farmer's Nemesis
passages.text:
Farmer Bruvk mentioned an ogre named Runk was leading the group here.

These creatures won't leave this place as long as that ogre is commanding them.

passages.title: Farmer's Nemesis
passages.text: We'll stay here and guard the remaining farmers while you handle Runk.

passages.title: Farmer's Nemesis
passages.text: This should help disperse the creatures. Without a leader they'll flee when Alliance and Horde reinforcements show up.

passages.title: Saving Stromgarde Keep
passages.text:
The plans you found indicate the ogres are trying to get food to supply a massive attack on Stromgarde Keep!

Or they're trying to use the crops to keep guarding an object named a storm. The translation was loose. 

It's safe to assume our problem is the former. Let's go!

passages.title: Saving Stromgarde Keep
passages.text: This looks bad, but it's nothing we can't handle.

passages.title: Clearing the Skies: A Fel of a Time
passages.text:
<The skies are full of residual time energy and demons pouring in from other timelines.

I should help Eternus by cleaning up the skies. The extra bronze energy would be nice too.>

passages.title: Clearing the Skies: A Fel of a Time
passages.text: <The skies are a little clearer now. The infinites might be interested in trading with this extra bronze I've collected.>

passages.title: Catapult Bombardment
passages.text:
These catapults are relentless. They must be destroyed.

Place these rune stones at their base. It'll unleash arcane magic to turn the catapults to dust.

I'll take out a few as well as I make my way across the battlefield.

passages.title: Catapult Bombardment
passages.text: Meet Jaina near Ar'gorok.

passages.title: Catapult Bombardment
passages.text: With the catapults gone the soldiers of Stromgarde should be able to gain the upperhand.

passages.title: Back to Stromgarde
passages.text:
I think we can count ourselves lucky there was no bigger threat here beyond a group of overambitious ogres. 

The same can't be said of other threats that are looming throughout Azeroth.

Come. Let's return to Stromgarde to discuss matters further.

passages.title: Back to Stromgarde
passages.text: It's good to see the people here in high spirits.

passages.title: As A Matter of Artifact
passages.text:
There's more to artifacts than meets the eye, <name>.

Simply using an artifact allows its legend to grow, and as that legend grows, so too does its power.

In order to unlock the full potential of that power, however, you'll need to focus infinite power into the artifact's traits. As more traits are empowered the artifact's true potential will be unlocked, and its legend will be undeniable.

Let's get started.

passages.title: As A Matter of Artifact
passages.text: Unlocking the full potential of your artifact will be key to understanding their impact on this timeline.

passages.title: As A Matter of Artifact
passages.text:
As you gather infinite power do not forget to focus it into your artifact.

The more power you invest, the swifter you will gather more infinite power and grow your artifact's legend--and your own.

passages.title: Titanic Rumblings
passages.text: Rumors are abuzz of titan forces being sighted around Khaz Algar. Brann has asked Dagran Thaurissan II for assistance in looking into these rumors.

passages.title: Titanic Rumblings
passages.text: If these rumors are true, we must investigate.

passages.title: Titan Consoles
passages.text:
Adventurer, the rumors are true. I've seen the titan forces and they are nae friendly. We must try tae discover why they are emergin' now and try and stop 'em from doin' too much damage.

Confront and stop these renegade constructs. To help ye, I've procured some Titan Consoles. I was able to set them up in the affected areas. I can use them to communicate with ye in the field. I am thinkin' we can use them to counter these titan forces as well.

passages.title: Titan Consoles
passages.text: <name>, these consoles are bein' overloaded by the titan's presence. If we can defeat them and secure titan discs, I think we can use 'em to empower the console to grant ye boons within the space. The boons can aid you in pushing back these rogue titan constructs.

passages.title: Titan Disc-Count
passages.text:
We need tae secure more titan discs. Venture deeper into this area, seek out the Titan Constructs, and defeat them. Ye should find disc shards. This console can reassemble them and access their data. 

Make sure tae search for any treasure rooms as well. The constructs appear to be assistin' the local denizens. Some of those locals might've secured additional titan discs with their other treasures.

passages.title: Titan Disc-Count
passages.text: Adventurer? Is that you?

passages.title: Titan Disc-Count
passages.text: Did ye find the shards? While ye were away, I remembered I'd found some on my visit to that location. Ye should find them in a pouch I hid next to the console.

passages.title: Overcharged Console
passages.text:
With the shards ye found, we can use the console tae restore the titan discs and use them to access powerful boons. 

Use the console's disc repair feature to create a titan disc, then use that disc to select a starting node in the overcharge console's interface.

passages.title: Overcharged Console
passages.text: Did it work?

passages.title: Overcharged Console
passages.text:
My remote console shows that there was a change. The overcharged console is funnelin' excess energy to a new node. This should grant ye that node's power when venturin' intae other areas where the titan constructs have emerged.

We'll use the titan force's own energy against 'em!

passages.title: Take the Darkwell!
passages.text:
We have our army but what lies behind these walls are the most powerful, most vile, and most empowered foes Xal'atath has in her arsenal. 

Gather your strongest allies, <name>, and meet us within. It is time to end this and take back our well.

passages.title: The Future of The Fel Hammer
passages.text:
Oh wait! Of course, right when I send you off I remember the most important thing!

The you-of-this-timeline made a critical choice for the future of all demon hunters. The follower they chose to be their personal champion created two diverging timelines for the fate of the Illidari.

You will need to choose which of these diverging timelines to explore. What rings true to you?

passages.title: The Future of The Fel Hammer
passages.text: Have you made a choice?

passages.title: The Future of The Fel Hammer
passages.text: Very well, we will study this version of the timeline. Let us see what the Illidari hold in their future--err, past.

passages.title: A Humble Servant
passages.text:
adventurer, residents of Hammerfall have been focused on daily life, defense, and survival over the past months. 

They have not had sufficient time, or frankly numbers, to address all the harms that were done.

There is much we can do to help them get back on their feet.

I know this is humble work, but it makes a very real difference to the orcs who live here.

passages.title: A Humble Servant
passages.text: There is much to do, <name>.

passages.title: A Humble Servant
passages.text: Good work, <name>. Things are starting to look better.

passages.title: Durable Information Storage Container
passages.text:
Adventurer, can you hear me? I've discovered a smaller titan device, the Durable Information Storage Container, which can fit on yer belt. I've deduced they'll be able tae play smaller titan discs, granting ye boons ye can use anywhere. 

Each of these devices need a jump start. If ye kick up enough dust in these delves it should generate a spark that the device will detect and collect. It should be enough tae power it for yer lifetime.

passages.title: Durable Information Storage Container
passages.text: The overcharging is key.

passages.title: Durable Information Storage Container
passages.text:
Attach the device. Yes! The device is powered on. 

Okay... If I just start the initialization sequence... and it's up. There are already two discs inside. And the menu will list areas where other miniature titan discs can be found. I'm thinkin' I can improve the device, but I need time. Find me later and see.

passages.title: Faerin's Request
passages.text:
<name>,

Geya'rah and Danath have arrived in Dornogal. They both seem upset about rising tensions in the Arathi Highlands. It sounds serious.

Can you come to Dornogal? I believe your presence can help the situation.

Faerin

passages.title: Faerin's Request
passages.text: <name>! Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Overcharged Delves
passages.text: Something has caused hostile titan constructs to activate and enter various caverns and spaces around Khaz Algar. Venture to these locations and investigate and eliminate the threat they pose.

passages.title: Worldsoul: Overcharged Delves
passages.text: It is unnerving to not know what has forced these hostile titan units to surface. But due to your efforts their threat is at an end.

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text:
Good, you've brought the supplies. Now, we begin the feast. We'll need plenty of food to keep up our strength.

The menu's simple, but worthy: Barley Stew, Stone-baked Pretzels, and a strong brew to fuel the Horde!

Are you prepared to learn?

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text: Start the fire and get to work!

passages.title: Brewmaster's Kitchen
passages.text: Hah! I can smell those pretzels from here. You've cooked up a feast fit to silence even the grumbling of dwarves!

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text:
Ah, you're here. Brewfest has begun-but we've got a problem. Can't have a proper feast without food, and some thieving hozen thought it'd be clever to snatch our grub.

Here's what you'll do: track down those hozen and take back what's ours. You might find a few bags just lying around too-grab those. Once you've got the goods, toss them in the wagon behind me.

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text: The feast won't come together without those ingredients!

passages.title: Gathering the Grub
passages.text: You've done it! The cooks will be pleased.

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text:
You've proven your strength at cooking, now it's time to prove it on the floor! Brewfest isn't just about feastin-it's about bringing the revelry to every corner of the camp.

You'll be taking orders, hauling plates, and pouring ale like a true warrior of celebration.

Now get out there and show them what real service looks like! Brewfest don't run on empty mugs!

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text: Remember to serve with a smile!

passages.title: Serving with Style
passages.text: I'd say you've earned yourself a break and a strong brew after all that work. But don't go getting soft on me! Brewfest isn't over, and there's still plenty of work to be done.

passages.title: Pesky Pests
passages.text:
Nearby creatures are suffering an infection of Light, and are being drawn to the Sunbath. Our guests find it disturbing. That is a problem, when one is trying to enjoy a tranquil escape from the world.

I confess, having one run into your leg while you are swimming can be unnerving.

Please, dissuade the invading sungrubs from joining us, and take to the sky to chase off those persistent butterflies.

passages.title: Pesky Pests
passages.text: Are the insects giving you trouble?

passages.title: Pesky Pests
passages.text:
That wasn't so bad, was it? 

Val does get a bit dramatic, but you performed wonderfully.

passages.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Normal)
passages.text:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.

passages.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Normal)
passages.text:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.

passages.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Normal)
passages.text:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.

passages.title: Prey: L-N-0R the Recycler (Normal)
passages.text:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, adventurer? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.

passages.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Normal)
passages.text:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.

Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.

passages.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Normal)
passages.text:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.

passages.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Normal)
passages.text:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.

passages.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Normal)
passages.text:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.

passages.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Normal)
passages.text:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.

passages.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Normal)
passages.text:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with. 
 
There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...

passages.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Normal)
passages.text:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.

passages.title: Prey: The Wing of Akil'zon (Normal)
passages.text:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.

passages.title: Prey: Ranger Swiftglade (Normal)
passages.text:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.

passages.title: Prey: Lieutenant Blazewing (Normal)
passages.text:
I do not know what to make of Lieutenant Blazewing. Her entire patrol disappeared during a reconnaissance mission into Zul'Aman. She was the sole survivor, but she returned with a fiery bloodlust and a complete disregard for the lives of others. 

Whether this is possession or sedition I am unsure, but she must be dealt with.

passages.title: Prey: Petyoll the Razorleaf (Normal)
passages.text:
Reports are coming in of shredded Farstriders adorned with petals and berries--entire patrols found strung up by razor-vines. There are more gruesome details, but they chafe even my... refined sensibilities. 

Hunt whatever manner of creature is embarking on this horrific killing spree, and see to it that its anguish is added to our crystals.

passages.title: Prey: Lamyne of the Undercroft (Normal)
passages.text:
Do you garden, adventurer? I've been known to dabble. It seems the plants in our realm are becoming somewhat overbearing these days, sprouting legs and arms and running around murdering our brave soldiers. 

Let's give them a bit of a pruning, shall we?

passages.title: Prey: High Vindicator Vureem (Normal)
passages.text:
High Vindicator Vureem is a victim of his own unyielding faith in the Light and the superiority it gives him. His crusade continues unabated and unresolved. He exists in a constant state of fury at the imperfectness of the world and those within it.

In the absence of total purity, Vureem sees only violence and the shadows of his own dogma. 

What say we put his worldview to the test?

passages.title: Prey: Crusader Luxia Maxwell (Normal)
passages.text:
We are not sure if Luxia Maxwell is a deserter or has simply decided to embark on her own personal crusade. Regardless, reports are coming in of her attacking both friend and foe alike, yelling aphorisms of purity and duty.

She has become a liability to the defense of Silvermoon. 

Go and harvest her anguish.

passages.title: Prey: Praetor Singularis (Normal)
passages.text:
The domanaar...

<Astalor shudders.>

I do not profess to know much about them, other than their proclivity for subterfuge, guile, and the absolute destruction of anything that stands before them. Praetor Singularis is no exception. They have been confounding our forces at every turn.

Go and put an end to their games.

passages.title: Prey: Consul Nebulor (Normal)
passages.text:
I have heard that there is one under Xal'atath's command who takes particular delight in dominating their foes. Whispers of a domanaar that taunts its victims with whispers and riddles before annihilating their mortal coil with void magic.
 
Consul Nebulor is their name.

Go and show them the limits of their power.

passages.title: Prey: Executor Kaenius (Normal)
passages.text:
The domanaar have a reputation for guile and cunning, but there are brutes among them: those who seek to dominate their victims through sheer power and force of will.

Executor Kaenius is one such domanaar.

They stalk the battlefield, singling out our strongest soldiers and viciously cutting them down.

Put an end to their rampage.

passages.title: Prey: Imperator Enigmalia (Normal)
passages.text:
Imperator Enigmalia is personally responsible for the deaths of at least a dozen Farstriders. I say "at least" because this particular domanaar makes it somewhat difficult to identify the bodies, so utterly destroyed are they.

Go and avenge our fallen soldiers.

passages.title: Prey: Knight-Errant Bloodshatter (Normal)
passages.text:
Death knights are unstable killing machines at the best of times. Knight-Errant Bloodshatter has forsaken any oath or promise that would ostensibly bind one of his kind to the bottom rungs of civilized society, and has gone completely rogue.
 
He is starting to become a liability. 

Recoup his anguish so that we can make the best of such an unfortunate situation.

passages.title: Prey: Vylenna the Defector (Normal)
passages.text:
Vylenna the Defector lives up to her name. After a recent engagement on the field of battle, she became so preoccupied with profaning the dead that she completely abandoned the duties ascribed to her.

Then her dereliction turned violent.

A veritable font of anguish if you ask me...

passages.title: Prey: Lost Theldrin (Normal)
passages.text:
Those of us who succumbed to our base desire for mana were slowly weeded out of civil society, if they survived at all. Theldrin is one such example, only it is a testament to his cunning and will to live that he has made it as long as he has.

He accepts no aid, choosing instead to stalk careless students and idle Magisters. His sole obsession is the mana that others possess...

See to it that he never harms another elf again.

passages.title: Prey: Neydra the Starving (Normal)
passages.text:
Poor Neydra... I knew her, in a previous life. She was full of vitality. Full of ambition. Unfortunately, she let that ambition get the best of her. She grew too enamored with the raw power of the arcane. She became resentful of all other things. Of all other people...

And now she is a murderous creature who beheads rats and attacks innocents in a desperate attempt to garner enough arcane energy to slake her unquenchable thirst.

It's funny, the paths life takes us...

passages.title: Prey: Thornspeaker Edgath (Normal)
passages.text:
This one presents a prickly problem indeed. Thornspeaker Edgath has made a name for himself by using his druidic powers not to preserve Azeroth, but to twist its strength both against his enemies and innocent bystanders alike. He has no regard for anything that is not a beast or growing in the ground.

It is time we clip this thorn.

passages.title: Prey: Thorn-Witch Liset (Normal)
passages.text:
Thorn-Witch Liset is a curse upon civilization and a blight upon the land itself. She twists the very trees and beasts, communing with the dark, evil things that live on the very edges of the natural realm.

I despise the natural realm.

passages.title: Prey: Grothoz, the Burning Shadow (Normal)
passages.text:
The Twilight's Blade are an embarrassing band of mediocre cultists and uninspired conspirators. Grothoz is the brains of a particularly stupid cabal that has been active in a nearby region. 

As his stupidity prevents him from using his whole brain, let us unlock his potential for him...

passages.title: Prey: Dengzag, the Darkened Blaze (Normal)
passages.text:
Do you know why the Twilight's Blade call Dengzag the "Darkened Blaze?" It is because they are stupid, small-minded, and utterly bereft of imagination. What a silly name indeed. 

I, however, am not small-minded. I have quite the prodigious mind, and it is currently intent on putting an end to Dengzag and whatever his tiny brain is up to. 

Get to it.

passages.title: Lost in Light
passages.text:
It seems some of our more adventurous guests have not returned from their hike. Val said he saw a rutaani skulking about earlier, but I was certain he was just trying to add some drama to our day.

The Lightbloom infiltrated the Sanctum to the north and has been spilling residual issues our way.

Our guests are here to escape the troubles of the world... This all could become a bit too real for them.

If you'll take care of that situation, I'll make sure Val keeps the guests distracted.

passages.title: Lost in Light
passages.text: Did they make it back?

passages.title: Lost in Light
passages.text:
Tormenting our guests was a step too far.

She encroached on the sunbath and has paid the price for her actions.

Thank you, new friend of the Solaar family!

passages.title: I am the Creator and Destroyer
passages.text:
Such a small thing, really. And devoid of any of the power T'uure once nurtured. But a relic of inestimable value nonetheless.

Did you know, <class>, that to T'uure, the dark and the light were inseparable aspects of a greater truth?

What creates, has the power to destroy in equal measure. Demonstrate this lesson and you will reach a new understanding of yourself, and of the great Naaru whose sacrifice was able to halt the annihilation of an entire planet.

passages.title: I am the Creator and Destroyer
passages.text:
Ah yes. I can sense the change in you. The growth that comes with meting out death in one hand, while nuturing life in the other.

Perhaps this small token will serve as a reminder of T'uure and his role in Dimensius' ultimate fate.

passages.title: A Piece of the Past
passages.text:
<This crystalline fragment has lost any luster it once had. Now finally extricated from Dimensius's dread form and in the hands of the devout, a brief glimmer revives in its depths.

Perhaps someone in Tazavesh will know more.>

passages.title: A Piece of the Past
passages.text: What is this? Ah, I see now. You were right to come to me.

passages.title: A Piece of the Past
passages.text:
A fragment of the lost naaru T'uure? And lodged in the form of Dimensius?

Now this is something I never thought I'd see.

passages.title: The Flame Burns Eternal
passages.text:
These Sureki sure are a persistent bunch! We need to match their persistence with our blades.

Can we count on your continued support in the battles ahead?

passages.title: The Flame Burns Eternal
passages.text: Ready yourself soldier, the battle is still to come.

passages.title: The Flame Burns Eternal
passages.text:
You've bought us a moment of peace.

Rest well, but always keep your blade sharp.

passages.title: Ultra Prime Deluxe Turbo-Boost: Powerhouse Challenges
passages.text:
<Undermine has a problem. Here's what we need. An established group, or just a bunch a ya really, ready to help out our pals in Undermine. Help clear out the worst of the competition, and we'll make it worth your time.

Complete the task, and collect a special reward from Consultant Wrexxle outside of the the Dornogal Treasury. Limited time offer. Some restrictions will apply.>

passages.title: Ultra Prime Deluxe Turbo-Boost: Powerhouse Challenges
passages.text: Yous looks out for us, and we return the favor. Right?

passages.title: Ultra Prime Deluxe Turbo-Boost: Powerhouse Challenges
passages.text:
Thanks, pal. Undermine is a mess right now. We'll take all the help we can get.

And hey, a deal's a deal. Here's what we owe.

We call this the jackpot reward for first time help. Check back again for more work!

passages.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Hard)
passages.text:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

I see something of myself in him.

Kill it for me.

passages.title: Prey: Magister Sunbreaker (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Once a noble Magister of Silvermoon, sworn to protect Quel'Thalas at any cost, he has broken away from the order and now seeks vengeance on his own terms.

passages.title: Prey: Magistrix Emberlash (Hard)
passages.text:
Alas, you can only catch so many innocent bystanders in your fireballs before you find yourself ostracized from polite society. Emberlash was always more interested in flame than friends...

She has burned one too many mutual acquaintances. 

If she will not control her power, we will gladly take it for our own.

passages.title: Prey: Senior Tinker Ozwold (Hard)
passages.text:
Rumor has it that Ozwold single-handedly raised insurance premiums in Gnomeregan before their little exodus. Be that as it may, he's consistently taken to perfecting his gadgetry regardless of the cost to others.

His ambition is admirable, but his methods are irredeemable. 

Go and see that his inventing days come to an end.

passages.text:
Do you know why they call her the Recycler, adventurer? I don't. And given her history of "disappearing" shop assistants, I'm not really inclined to ask her.

That being said, watch your step. I understand that she likes to incorporate her victims into her gadgetry. We wouldn't want you becoming a pocket watch or some such thing.

passages.title: Prey: Mordril Shadowfell (Hard)
passages.text:
The Void is a perfidious thing, like water. The wise keep it at a respectful distance, never dancing too close to the edge. The foolish dive in, and in so doing, drown.
 
Mordril is a danger to himself and everyone around him, so lost is he in his own obsession.

See to it that he no longer poses a threat to this realm.

passages.title: Prey: Deliah Gloomsong (Hard)
passages.text:
In a previous life, Deliah Gloomsong was a prodigious student--truly a marvel of ambition, talent, and unrelenting curiosity. 

It was the latter that got the best of her.

Put an end to her murderous spree.

passages.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Hard)
passages.text:
Ethereals... they make my skin crawl. Esoteric. Unknowable. I don't trust anything I can't look in the eyes while it grovels before me.

My scouts report that a particularly dangerous ethereal is active in a nearby region. We would do well to nip this in the bud while we still can.

passages.title: Prey: Phaseblade Talasha (Hard)
passages.text: It looks like your limbs are intact and there's nary a knife in your back. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Prey: Nexus-Edge Hadim (Hard)
passages.text:
Our activities are drawing unwanted attention. I have heard whispers that a powerful ethereal assassin is on my... on our trail. It would be very difficult indeed to defend our city as twin piles of bloody ribbons.

Go out there and show this "assassin" the true art of the kill.

passages.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Hard)
passages.text:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more! 

Kill him. Feed his anguish to the defenses of our beloved city.

passages.title: Prey: Jo'zolo the Breaker (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Jo'zolo the Breaker is a troll who abides by his name. Long has he been the bane of our scouts, but no more!

passages.title: Prey: Zadu, Fist of Nalorakk (Hard)
passages.text:
Our neighbors produce some of the most skilled hunters in all of Azeroth. It is a shame they are so difficult to reason with. 
 
There is one named Zadu. Her anguish would make for a most excellent trophy...

passages.title: Prey: The Talon of Jan'alai (Hard)
passages.text:
There is a powerful troll shaman who calls himself the Talon of Jan'alai. Long has he confounded our city's Farstriders, sowing confusion and death in his wake.

See to it that he joins the spirits he so ardently venerates.

passages.text:
Do you smell that? There is death on the air. This can only mean one thing. The Wing of Akil'zon is near. Go out and slay her.

Oh, and be careful. She's responsible for more than one lost Farstrider patrol.

passages.text:
It is a difficult thing, to hunt one of our own. Ranger Swiftglade is beyond redemption. His bloodlust could not be sated against our foes, and he has since turned his martial prowess upon his own people.

End his sadistic killing spree and put his anguish to better use.

Recoup his anguish so that we can make the best of such an unfortunate situation.

passages.title: Prey: Vylenna the Defector (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Vylenna the Defector lives up to her name. After a recent engagement on the field of battle, she became so preoccupied with profaning the dead that she completely abandoned the duties ascribed to her.

Then her dereliction turned violent.

A veritable font of anguish if you ask me...

passages.title: Prey: Lost Theldrin (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Those of us who succumbed to our base desire for mana were slowly weeded out of civil society, if they survived at all. Theldrin is one such example, only it is a testament to his cunning and will to live that he has made it as long as he has.

He accepts no aid, choosing instead to stalk careless students and idle Magisters. His sole obsession is the mana that others possess...

See to it that he never harms another elf again.

passages.title: Prey: Neydra the Starving (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Poor Neydra... I knew her, in a previous life. She was full of vitality. Full of ambition. Unfortunately, she let that ambition get the best of her. She grew too enamored with the raw power of the arcane. She became resentful of all other things. Of all other people...

And now she is a murderous creature who beheads rats and attacks innocents in a desperate attempt to garner enough arcane energy to slake her unquenchable thirst.

It's funny, the paths life takes us...

passages.title: Prey: Thornspeaker Edgath (Nightmare)
passages.text:
This one presents a prickly problem indeed. Thornspeaker Edgath has made a name for himself by using his druidic powers not to preserve Azeroth, but to twist its strength both against his enemies and innocent bystanders alike. He has no regard for anything that is not a beast or growing in the ground.

It is time we clip this thorn.

passages.title: Prey: Thorn-Witch Liset (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Thorn-Witch Liset is a curse upon civilization and a blight upon the land itself. She twists the very trees and beasts, communing with the dark, evil things that live on the very edges of the natural realm.

I despise the natural realm.

passages.title: Prey: Grothoz, the Burning Shadow (Nightmare)
passages.text:
The Twilight's Blade are an embarrassing band of mediocre cultists and uninspired conspirators. Grothoz is the brains of a particularly stupid cabal that has been active in a nearby region. 

As his stupidity prevents him from using his whole brain, let us unlock his potential for him...

passages.title: Prey: Dengzag, the Darkened Blaze (Nightmare)
passages.text:
Do you know why the Twilight's Blade call Dengzag the "Darkened Blaze?" It is because they are stupid, small-minded, and utterly bereft of imagination. What a silly name indeed. 

I, however, am not small-minded. I have quite the prodigious mind, and it is currently intent on putting an end to Dengzag and whatever his tiny brain is up to. 

Get to it.

passages.title: A Fish!
passages.text:
There is a deliciously delectable dish that I am dying to share with my guests. We start with just the right fish, then chop it up, drop it in a blend of citrus and our special savory seasonings, and let it bask in the glorious flavors.

In the shake of a tail feather, it becomes a magical delight for the senses!

We are the talk of the town, you know. Could you please procure for us the perfect fish?

passages.title: A Fish!
passages.text: I have a great feeling about this one!

passages.title: A Fish!
passages.text:
Excellent work, <name>! You have procured a perfectly, pleasingly, plumply proportioned pescatarian prize!

Joyous day!

passages.title: Midnight
passages.text: Locate one of the images of Lady Liadrin that have appeared across Azeroth.

passages.title: Midnight
passages.text: I am glad you came, <name>. We need your help urgently.

passages.title: A Path Not Yet Chosen
passages.text:
I'm trying to figure out what career path to follow, but I keep second-guessing myself. The Farstriders, the Blood Knights, the Magisters... they all seem so incredible that I can't decide.

I was hoping if I spoke to each and earned a recommendation, I might finally understand where I'm meant to be. Would you help me?

passages.title: A Path Not Yet Chosen
passages.text: I really hope I find where I belong...

passages.title: A Path Not Yet Chosen
passages.text:
Wow... I can't believe I actually got all three recommendations. They all said such kind things, but now I feel even more torn than before!

Do you think... perhaps you could help me choose?

passages.title: How to Train Your Protege
passages.text:
I did everything they asked--the trials, the lessons--and they all said I did well... but I still don't know where I truly belong.

Each path felt right in its own way, and now my heart feels pulled in three directions.

Please... could you help me decide?

passages.title: How to Train Your Protege
passages.text:
Ah... so the boy has chosen at last. He has heart--too much perhaps.

Yes. This will be recorded and honored. You've done more than deliver a message--you've helped shape a life. Thank you.

passages.title: Secret Ingredients
passages.text:
Our gregarious guests have partaken so much from our stores that we are running dangerously low of our special Solaarian sintalia.

The rich taste of belanise, with its intoxicating scent, contrasts perfectly with the sharp tartness of the local berries. Carefully prepared then soaked in our special blend of spirits, then served--it's to die for!

Just between us, if the berries are not handled just right, the infusion can be quite deadly. Otherwise... delicious, invigorating, purifying, glorious!

passages.title: Secret Ingredients
passages.text: Are you gathering carefully?

passages.title: Secret Ingredients
passages.text:
Magic! Perfection! You could not be more skilled if I had wished you into existence.

That is an interesting thought. Could I have?

passages.title: Harvest of Darkness
passages.text:
You... make yourself useful.

As a master of terrible beasts, it is my job to mold these hatchlings into dreaded beasts. I pit them against each other and they grow ever more violent.

But the elves here insist that I will yield better results with just a bit of... tender loving care. Let us put this to the test.

This runt is Fidoficus. You will show him tenderness and affection, and then we will see how ferocious he becomes.

Collect some delicious dietary treats for him and return to me.

passages.title: Harvest of Darkness
passages.text: These ingredients will make for a highly nutritious and equally delectable meal.

passages.title: Harvest of Darkness
passages.text:
Fidoficus will be renowned for his ferocity.

I can see the violence growing in him.

One day, he will be a worthy pet for a domanaar such as myself.

passages.title: [DNT] QUEST NOT USED
The Silence at Fungara Village
passages.text:
Fungara Village has been silent for some time now.

We've largely been occupied with the Lightbloom and the threat it presents, so we haven't had time to check in on the fungarians to the east. Usually, they are rowdy yet manageable... but it's rare that they go completely silent.

I am going to investigate. If you wish to prove yourself an ally, you would do well to join me.

passages.title: The Silence at Fungara Village
passages.text: Normally, I would refuse the intervention of an outsider without a second thought... but given the situation, perhaps you can be of some help.

passages.title: Little Monsters
passages.text:
When I sent a request for aid from Har'alnor, I did not expect them to send me an outsider. No matter.

The denizens of Fungara Village have gone quiet. Normally, I would be thrilled: they're horribly screechy. But the way they are shambling about... it is like they have forgotten that they yet live.

<Ghikal shudders.>

I tried to get close, but they attacked me on sight.

I will need samples of their flesh. Go and bring them to me, so I can see what has happened here.

passages.title: Little Monsters
passages.text: I do not know what is going on, but to err on the side of caution... do not let them bite you, hrm? Whatever plagues them may be infectious.

passages.title: Little Monsters
passages.text:
Goddess forfend. This is not fungarian flesh at all.

What ARE they?

passages.title: Spawn of the Dead
passages.text:
It is obvious that something terrible has happened in the village. I can see the corpses of their largest specimens strewn across the southern reaches from here, but something is off about them too. Fungarians don't usually just leave the corpses of their kin lying about.

And though I am watching from afar, I swear that some of them are... twitching.

Investigate. Find out what you can, and report back to me.

passages.title: Spawn of the Dead
passages.text:
This is so much worse than I thought.

We have to find the source of this and destroy it before it infects something bigger and more dangerous than a fungarian.

passages.title: You Are Legend
passages.text:
Whatever these things are, they're not fungarians. Not anymore. 

Har'alnor has enough to worry about with the Lightbloom as it is. It cannot afford to be trapped between its forces and these... things.

Do what must be done. Destroy as many of them as you can.

passages.title: You Are Legend
passages.text: Do not feel regret. These things are not alive anymore. Not in any way that matters.

passages.title: You Are Legend
passages.text: You are quite the accomplished slayer of aberrations. Perhaps you should consider a vocation in monster-hunting.

passages.title: Decayed Land
passages.text:
As far as I can tell, these fungarians are all already dead. Something is animating their corpses from within, like puppets attached to unseen vines.

This fungal matter that's infesting them must be coming from somewhere... and judging from the size of the ones further north, we'll find plenty of it there. Find it, get rid of it, but for Aln'hara's sake don't breathe it in.

passages.title: Decayed Land
passages.text:
We've culled the worst of the growths to the north... but there are smaller ones already beginning to sprout. Where are they coming from?

There must be a source, and we'll have to find it if we mean to solve this thing.

passages.title: Belly of the Beast
passages.text:
I normally raise my beasts on a diet of raw, bloody carcasses and souls ripped asunder by the Void.

But we shall try your mortal ways.

I hear you... cook? And that makes the treat better?

Do this. Then, take him on a walk around the Howling Ridge. Even I know exercise is good for digestion.

Only the most ferocious of creatures is worthy of serving me. I hope neither you nor Fido disappoint me.

passages.title: Belly of the Beast
passages.text: He is still small, but one day, he will grow to be a terrible foe.

passages.title: Belly of the Beast
passages.text:
Is the beast's savagery growing?

I'm sure I will begin to hear of his violence from those around the Howling Ridge.

passages.title: Reticent Evil
passages.text:
I do not understand. We've searched high and low, north and south. Everywhere we go, we find animated corpses and small fruiting fungus, but where is the central body? Where is--

Oh, goddess. Of course.

The water, <class>. Check the water.

passages.title: Reticent Evil
passages.text:
It is done, then.

You did well to survive untainted. The wilds are a dangerous place, and survival is never a guarantee.

Now go. I must remain and ensure that these abominations cannot spread any further.

passages.title: Mighty and Superior
passages.text:
The beast is fed and exercised. Imagine, mortal... one day his maw will grow to fit you inside it a thousand times over. 

Now, we will test his potential for true violence. 

There is a beast that has laid claim to a den south of the Howling Ridge. 

Fidoficus trusts you now. Go with him and bear witness to his might.

passages.title: Mighty and Superior
passages.text: Fidoficus has grown fearsome, and perhaps you have claim to some of his growth.

passages.title: Mighty and Superior
passages.text:
Fidoficus will grow so terribly large, that it is he who will be walking you. 

Only then will he be worthy of joining me as my attack behemoth.

passages.title: Still Scouting
passages.text:
When the Alliance originally fought the Horde here, Kurdran served as a scout. He's still an excellent one. He took his gryphon to Blackrock Mountain to see what kind of forces we may be dealing with there.

Meet up with him and see what kind of trouble you can cause.

passages.title: Still Scouting
passages.text: Arator, <name>--thanks fer coming. Plenty o' Dark Horde in there.

passages.title: Tomes of Terror
passages.text:
Knowledge is power, and de ogres been reading.

Bring me dey tomes so dey never grow dis powah again.

passages.title: Tomes of Terror
passages.text: Get me de tomes.

passages.title: Tomes of Terror
passages.text: Thank ya. Dese are going straight into de fire.

passages.title: Ashes of the Void
passages.text:
De void elementals have one use.

De dust dey drop is useful for shadow magic rituals.

Collect some for our tribe.

passages.title: Ashes of the Void
passages.text: Don't worry, we been doin' dese rituals for centuries.

passages.title: Ashes of the Void
passages.text: Our hunters gonna make good use of de powder. Thank ya.

passages.title: Blades of the Fallen
passages.text:
After de battle we left a lot of our weapons behind.

Please go collect dem so de Twilight's Blade doesn't get dem.

passages.title: Blades of the Fallen
passages.text: Thanks for collecting dem. Now our foes won't get de advantage of fine Amani crafting.

passages.title: Dead by Dusk
passages.text: De Twilight's Blade cultists have de audacity to try and take back our temple. Kill de peons and bring me their femurs.

passages.title: Dead by Dusk
passages.text: Why femurs? None of ya business.

passages.title: Dead by Dusk
passages.text: I got a plan for de bones. Thanks.

passages.title: Ultra Deadly Ultradon
passages.text:
I saw some of de void elementals doing a sketchy ritual in de center of the battlefield. It looked like dey were summoning some void creatures.

Make sure whatever dey summon is dealt with.

passages.title: Ultra Deadly Ultradon
passages.text: If dey start bringing the void here we're gonna be in a whole heap o' trouble.

passages.title: Ultra Deadly Ultradon
passages.text: Never seen one of dem before and hope I don't see dem again. Nicely done.

passages.title: Far from the Hinterlands
passages.text:
As a Torntusk of de Revantusk tribe, I am cautious of Witherbark because of our history with dem in de Hinterlands. My family moved here because of dem.

The Witherbark here in Zul'Aman seem to respect us, but de Witherbark I remember in de Hinterlands killed and backstabbed their allies for power.

They worshipped de spider loa, Shadra.

When de Hinterlands's Witherbark temple Shadra'Alor fell, de Witherbark must have fled somewhere. Look around for evidence of Hinterlands Witherbark and of Shadra.

passages.title: Far from the Hinterlands
passages.text:
All de places dey mentioned are right next door to Shadra'Alor! Dey probably worshipped Shadra.

We can't trust dem. Dey are like de venoms dey use. Dey will poison de rest of de tribe against de Revatusk--against us all!

passages.title: The Eye of the Loa
passages.text:
I lost friends to venoms made from Shadra's spiders in de Hinterlands. I gotta know if Shadra's lurkin' around here, twistin' de minds of these Witherbark. No Revantusk will be safe in Zul'Aman with Shadra-worshippin' Witherbark around!

Maybe I seem paranoid, but I have my reasons. And you have Halazzi's ear. You could ask him to reveal to you any hidden spiders, yes? I know those long ears can hear dem skitterin'!

There is a shrine behind me. Stand in front of it and see if he'll grant you a boon.

passages.title: The Eye of the Loa
passages.text: Did Halazzi help you? He can hear anything, but he also can see what's hidden in shadow.

passages.title: The Eye of the Loa
passages.text:
De spiders fled? I thought dey would put up more of a fight. And you said dey were small? Hm.

Well, it doesn't matter. Halazzi has set us on this hunt now. We need to see it through.

passages.title: Seeking Shadra
passages.text:
We will untangle dis mess about Witherbark and Vilebranch soon enough. De loa Shadra and her schemes must be our first priority.

I watched the spiders run in terror from you, and somethin' struck me. De spiders are not just running in panic--they're going somewhere... somewhere dey feel safe, and even I can see dem now. 

Dey are not hiding anymore. Dey are on de run! Our hunt continues.

Let's follow dem.

passages.title: Seeking Shadra
passages.text: Where dis trail leads, we follow.

passages.title: Seeking Shadra
passages.text: Let's hear him out, but keep your hand on your weapon.

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Deep in Maisara
passages.text:
Shadra has asked dat we recover de third piece of Mixer Jamanga's ritual, de Shell of Shadra. With it, maybe we can bring her back.

She recognized both de Witherbark and Revantusk as her allies. I felt her approval upon all of us. I believe this is de right choice.

Halazzi set us on dis path, and we each got our roles to see it through. Gather your allies and go into Maisara Caverns! I would expect one of their leaders to hold de shell. Kill dem and take it back.

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Deep in Maisara
passages.text: I think dat Shadra will honor her word.

passages.title: Maisara Caverns: Deep in Maisara
passages.text: I can't imagine dat was easy. Halazzi must have blessed your hunt.

passages.title: A Twilight Oath's End
passages.text:
<The ancient runes on the page seem to twist under your gaze. Their power seems to be rapidly fading.>

<Ve'nari would be interested in this.>

passages.title: A Twilight Oath's End
passages.text:
Salhadaar cheated death to revive Dimensius, and cheated death again by escaping your wrath.

<Ve'nari pauses for a moment.>

A pity he escaped, but the All-Devouring has perished. Thank you.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Worldly Deeds
passages.text:
All across the Broken Isles there are people in need. They search for hope but are hard pressed to find any. You can be that hope.

Seek out those in peril in the Broken Isles and be the champion they so desperately need.

It is through such acts that legends are made.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Worldly Deeds
passages.text: A single heroic act can turn the tide. A single whisper of hope can turn back despair. This is what gives legends their power.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Invasion Points
passages.text:
The Legion does not fight conventionally. They deceive, manipulate, and undermine their opposition at every turn.

There are no battle lines against the Legion. They will open rifts at a weak point and then spill out of it sowing death and destruction. When they invade, it is on their terms.

However, this strategy is not invincible. Potent champions, able to move and react swiftly, can stop these invasions at their source. Stop the Legion Invasion. Show people that the Legion can be defeated.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Invasion Points
passages.text: The power you and your artifact possess were able to halt a Legion invasion. But was it you, or the artifact you wield, that is responsible? On that I will require more information.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Hero of the Broken Isles
passages.text:
Heroic deeds are a matter of perspective. What may seem trivial to a mighty hero such as you, could mean the world to another.

Seek out those in need and aid them in whatever task they deem important. In doing so your legend will grow.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Hero of the Broken Isles
passages.text: Your name is on the minds of the people, and is shared around the fire. The greater your legend becomes, the more powerful your name will be. But does the power of one's name eclipse that of the artifact they wield? This is the burning question.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Greater Invasion Points
passages.text:
Once the Legion has sown confusion and chaos, then they will begin their real assault. Huge invasion rifts will open and the Legion will march forth in great numbers. The defenders, scattered to protect against smaller rifts, will lack sufficient strength anywhere to stop them.

That is when champions like you are most needed.

Seek out one of the Legion's major invasions and throw everything you have at it. 

Show the people that with enough determination you can cancel the apocalypse.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Greater Invasion Points
passages.text: Just as I predicted. You were able to stop a massive Legion invasion. It was not you, or your artifact that did this. Rather it was the combination of both that won the day.

passages.title: Eco-Dome Al'dani
passages.text:
We have received word from Ve'nari that the Wastelanders continue to stand in the way of progress on K'aresh. They threaten the most promising eco-dome.

The restoration directive of K'aresh must not be interrupted.

Put an end to these inefficiencies.

passages.title: Eco-Dome Al'dani
passages.text: Have you put an end to their efforts?

passages.title: Eco-Dome Al'dani
passages.text:
This is a promising beginning to our new relationship with K'aresh.

Good work, outlander.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare study, so focus on fighting rare opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Elite
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be an elite study, so focus on fighting elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Elite
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare Elites
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a rare elite study, so focus on fighting rare elite opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Rare Elites
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a demonology study, so focus on fighting demonic opponents so that we can get a better understanding of your abilities.

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text: We need more fight data to complete our study, and time is running short.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Demonology
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Terrors of the Broken Isles
passages.text:
It is time to put both you and your artifact to the test.

Seek out a Terror of the Broken Isles and defeat them.

I am certain that, no matter the outcome, you will provide us with much to think about. I will be watching with great interest.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Heroic Terrors of the Broken Isles
passages.text: A fascinating outcome, <name>. This will shed some much needed light on our research.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Empowerment
passages.text:
In order to better understand the power of both you and your artifact in this timeline we need to undertake some combat studies. It is like social studies, but with blunt force trauma.

This will be a study of the empowered enemies in the experimental, fractured timeline. We need to understand how your abilities fare in the face of terrifying change. 

And remember, this is for the greater good.

passages.title: Infinite Research: Advanced Combat Studies, Empowerment
passages.text: Well done, <name>. Moratari will be overjoyed to see these new data points.

passages.title: Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow
passages.text:
Hero, can you hear me? There's a translocator the Shadowguard uses to send cargo to their reserves that can carry you directly to their post beneath the Manaforge. An ambush they'll never see coming!

There is of course, a catch. We do not have clearance to use their supply lines... so we need you to procure some for us. Take down the highest-ranking member of the Shadowguard you can find, return with identification, and we'll forge you a one-way ticket to the front lines.

passages.title: Manaforge Omega: A Walking Shadow
passages.text: That certainly qualifies as high-ranking, <name>! After I work my magic, that translocator is as good as ours. Next stop, enemy territory!

passages.title: Aiding the Green Dragons
passages.text:
Nozdormu and Queen Alexstrasza believe the best path forward is to aid the Green Dragons.

Like the Black Dragons, the Greens lack a true aspect to lead them. 

Merithra is currently hosting guests within the Emerald Gardens. Meet with her to see if you can aid her.

I will continue tracking the incarnates and the other dracthyr.

passages.title: Aiding the Green Dragons
passages.text:
Thank you for coming, <name>. My guests are eager to see the Emerald Gardens, and I am pleased to host them.

Shall we get started?

passages.title: Incarnates on the Move
passages.text:
<name>, I thought I'd find you here. I bring word from the other aspects and my scouts.

The incarnates are on the move. I know not what they're planning, but you should be aware of their actions.

passages.title: Incarnates on the Move
passages.text: The incarnates are looking for something. It's imperative we get more of the flights empowered to stop them.

passages.title: Behind Enemy Lines
passages.text: My friend, we've finished working on some new tools to ensure you'll do some real damage to the Shadowguard. Come by and let's sort it out together.

passages.title: Behind Enemy Lines
passages.text: My friend! Thanks to our informants inside the Manaforge, we've uncovered some technology that can help you bring it down. This translocator has been calibrated to project your soul back here for a few moments, allowing you to access whatever you may need--but be warned. The pull of Omega's energy fields are strong, and will rip your essence back to your body's position in short order. I'm told it's... quite painful. Still, any advantage is a good advantage. Make haste!
